decls.name: TauCeti.IsAspherical
decls.doc:
A based space is aspherical when it is path-connected and every homotopy group in
dimension at least two is trivial.
decls.statement: def IsAspherical (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.isAspherical_iff
decls.doc: Characteristic restatement of asphericity.
decls.statement:
theorem isAspherical_iff {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} :
    IsAspherical X x ↔
      PathConnectedSpace X ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, Subsingleton (π_ (n + 2) X x)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsAspherical.mk
decls.doc:
Construct asphericity from path-connectedness and the vanishing of all homotopy groups
in dimensions at least two.
decls.statement:
theorem mk (hX : PathConnectedSpace X)
    (hπ : ∀ n : ℕ, Subsingleton (π_ (n + 2) X x)) : IsAspherical X x

decls.name: TauCeti.IsAspherical.pathConnectedSpace
decls.doc: An aspherical space is path-connected.
decls.statement: theorem pathConnectedSpace (h : IsAspherical X x) : PathConnectedSpace X

decls.name: TauCeti.IsAspherical.subsingleton_homotopyGroup
decls.doc: Every homotopy group of an aspherical space in dimension at least two is trivial.
decls.statement:
theorem subsingleton_homotopyGroup (h : IsAspherical X x) (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (π_ (n + 2) X x)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsAspherical.of_homeomorph
decls.doc: Asphericity is preserved by a pointed homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem of_homeomorph (hX : IsAspherical X x) (e : X ≃ₜ Y) (he : e x = y) :
    IsAspherical Y y

decls.name: TauCeti.IsAspherical.prod
decls.doc: The product of two aspherical spaces is aspherical.
decls.statement:
theorem prod (hX : IsAspherical X x) (hY : IsAspherical Y y) :
    IsAspherical (X × Y) (x, y)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsAspherical.pi
decls.doc: An indexed product of aspherical spaces is aspherical.
decls.statement:
theorem pi (h : ∀ i, IsAspherical (Z i) (z i)) :
    IsAspherical (∀ i, Z i) z

decls.name: TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne
decls.doc:
A based space is an Eilenberg--Mac Lane space of type `K(G, 1)` when it is aspherical
and its fundamental group is isomorphic to `G`.
decls.statement:
def IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne (G : Type u) [Group G]
    (X : Type v) [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.isEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne_iff
decls.doc: Characteristic restatement of the `K(G, 1)` property.
decls.statement:
theorem isEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne_iff {G : Type u} [Group G]
    {X : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X] {x : X} :
    IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne G X x ↔
      IsAspherical X x ∧ Nonempty (FundamentalGroup X x ≃* G)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne.mk
decls.doc:
Construct the `K(G, 1)` property from asphericity and an isomorphism between the
fundamental group and `G`.
decls.statement:
theorem mk (hX : IsAspherical X x)
    (hπ : Nonempty (FundamentalGroup X x ≃* G)) :
    IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne G X x

decls.name: TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne.isAspherical
decls.doc: A `K(G, 1)` space is aspherical.
decls.statement:
theorem isAspherical (h : IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne G X x) :
    IsAspherical X x

decls.name: TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne.nonempty_fundamentalGroupMulEquiv
decls.doc: The fundamental group of a `K(G, 1)` space is isomorphic to `G`.
decls.statement:
theorem nonempty_fundamentalGroupMulEquiv
    (h : IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne G X x) :
    Nonempty (FundamentalGroup X x ≃* G)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne.of_mulEquiv
decls.doc: Transporting the target group along an isomorphism preserves the `K(G, 1)` property.
decls.statement:
theorem of_mulEquiv (h : IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne G X x) (e : G ≃* H) :
    IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne H X x

decls.name: TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne.of_homeomorph
decls.doc: The `K(G, 1)` property is preserved by a pointed homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
theorem of_homeomorph (h : IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne G X x)
    (e : X ≃ₜ Y) (he : e x = y) :
    IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne G Y y

decls.name: TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne.prod
decls.doc:
The product of a `K(G₁, 1)` space and a `K(G₂, 1)` space is a
`K(G₁ × G₂, 1)` space.
decls.statement:
theorem prod (h₁ : IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne G₁ X₁ x₁)
    (h₂ : IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne G₂ X₂ x₂) :
    IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne (G₁ × G₂) (X₁ × X₂) (x₁, x₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne.pi
decls.doc: An indexed product of `K(Gᵢ, 1)` spaces is a `K(Π i, Gᵢ, 1)` space.
decls.statement:
theorem pi (h : ∀ i, IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne (G' i) (Z i) (z i)) :
    IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne (∀ i, G' i) (∀ i, Z i) z

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.basepointChangeSubgroup
decls.doc:
The subgroup of `π₁(X, x₁)` obtained from `H ≤ π₁(X, x₀)` by changing basepoint along a
path `γ : Path x₀ x₁`. This is the subgroup-level form of conjugating loops by `γ`.

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.mem_basepointChangeSubgroup
decls.doc: Membership in the subgroup transported along a basepoint-change path.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_basepointChangeSubgroup (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀))
    (g : _root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁) :
    g ∈ basepointChangeSubgroup γ H ↔
      ∃ h ∈ H, _root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ h = g

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.mem_basepointChangeSubgroup_iff
decls.doc:
Membership in a transported subgroup, expressed by applying the inverse basepoint-change
isomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_basepointChangeSubgroup_iff (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀))
    (g : _root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁) :
    g ∈ basepointChangeSubgroup γ H ↔
      (_root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ).symm g ∈ H

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.le_basepointChangeSubgroup_iff
decls.doc:
A subgroup of the target fundamental group is contained in the transported subgroup iff
its inverse basepoint-change image is contained in the original subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma le_basepointChangeSubgroup_iff (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    (K : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁))
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀)) :
    K ≤ basepointChangeSubgroup γ H ↔
      K.map (((_root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ).symm) :
        _root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁ →* _root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀) ≤ H

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.basepointChangeSubgroup_le_iff
decls.doc:
The transported subgroup is contained in a target subgroup iff the original subgroup is
contained in the target subgroup's inverse image under basepoint change.
decls.statement:
lemma basepointChangeSubgroup_le_iff (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀))
    (K : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁)) :
    basepointChangeSubgroup γ H ≤ K ↔
      H ≤ K.comap (((_root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ) :
        _root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀ →* _root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁))

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.basepointChangeSubgroup_mono
decls.doc: Basepoint-change transport is monotone on subgroups.
decls.statement:
lemma basepointChangeSubgroup_mono (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    {H K : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀)} (h : H ≤ K) :
    basepointChangeSubgroup γ H ≤ basepointChangeSubgroup γ K

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.basepointChangeSubgroup_normal_iff
decls.doc: Normality is invariant under basepoint-change transport.
decls.statement:
lemma basepointChangeSubgroup_normal_iff (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀)) :
    (basepointChangeSubgroup γ H).Normal ↔ H.Normal

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.basepointChangeSubgroup.normal
decls.doc: A normal subgroup remains normal after basepoint-change transport.
decls.statement:
lemma basepointChangeSubgroup.normal (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    {H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀)} (hH : H.Normal) :
    (basepointChangeSubgroup γ H).Normal

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv
decls.doc: The normalizer quotient `N(H) / H` transported along a basepoint-change path.
decls.statement:
def basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀)) :
    Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H ≃*
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotient (basepointChangeSubgroup γ H)

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv_mk
decls.doc:
On normalizer representatives, basepoint-change transport is induced by the
path-conjugation isomorphism of fundamental groups.
decls.statement:
lemma basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv_mk (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀))
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀))) :
    basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv γ H (g : Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) =
      ((MulEquiv.subgroupCongr (by rw [basepointChangeSubgroup])
          (Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap H
            (_root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ) g) :
          _root_.Subgroup.normalizer
            ((basepointChangeSubgroup γ H) : Set (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁))) :
        Subgroup.normalizerQuotient (basepointChangeSubgroup γ H))

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv_symm_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse basepoint-change transport sends a target representative to the inverse
path-conjugation representative.
decls.statement:
lemma basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv_symm_mk (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀))
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer
      ((basepointChangeSubgroup γ H) : Set (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁))) :
    (basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv γ H).symm
        (g : Subgroup.normalizerQuotient (basepointChangeSubgroup γ H)) =
      (((Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap H
          (_root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ)).symm
          ((MulEquiv.subgroupCongr (by rw [basepointChangeSubgroup])).symm g)) :
        Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H)

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv_mk_coe
decls.doc:
On representatives, basepoint-change transport applies the path-conjugation isomorphism
of fundamental groups.
decls.statement:
lemma basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv_mk_coe (γ : Path x₀ x₁)
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀))
    (g : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀))) :
    basepointChangeNormalizerQuotientEquiv γ H (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H g) =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk (basepointChangeSubgroup γ H)
        (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr (by rw [basepointChangeSubgroup])
          (⟨_root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ
              (g : _root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀),
            by
              rw [← Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_apply_coe H
                (_root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ) g]
              exact (Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap H
                (_root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ) g).2⟩ :
            _root_.Subgroup.normalizer
              ((H.map ((_root_.FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ) :
                _root_.FundamentalGroup X x₀ →* _root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁)) :
                  Set (_root_.FundamentalGroup X x₁))))

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.map_fromPath
decls.doc: Mapping a loop class represented by a path is represented by mapping that path.
decls.statement:
theorem FundamentalGroup.map_fromPath {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X, Y)) (base : X)
    (q : Path base base) :
    _root_.FundamentalGroup.map f base (_root_.FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦q⟧) =
      _root_.FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦q.map f.continuous⟧

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.map_range_eq_bot_of_subsingleton
decls.doc:
If the source fundamental group is subsingleton, the range of any induced map from it is
trivial.
decls.statement:
theorem FundamentalGroup.map_range_eq_bot_of_subsingleton
    [Subsingleton (_root_.FundamentalGroup A a₀)] (f : C(A, X)) :
    (_root_.FundamentalGroup.map f a₀).range = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.map_range_eq_bot_of_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc: A simply connected domain has trivial induced fundamental-group range.
decls.statement:
theorem FundamentalGroup.map_range_eq_bot_of_simplyConnectedSpace [SimplyConnectedSpace A]
    (f : C(A, X)) (a₀ : A) :
    (_root_.FundamentalGroup.map f a₀).range = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.map_range_le_of_subsingleton
decls.doc:
If the source fundamental group is subsingleton, its induced-map range lies in any target
subgroup.
decls.statement:
theorem FundamentalGroup.map_range_le_of_subsingleton
    [Subsingleton (_root_.FundamentalGroup A a₀)] (f : C(A, X))
    (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X (f a₀))) :
    (_root_.FundamentalGroup.map f a₀).range ≤ H

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.map_range_le_of_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
A simply connected domain has induced fundamental-group range contained in any target
subgroup.
decls.statement:
theorem FundamentalGroup.map_range_le_of_simplyConnectedSpace [SimplyConnectedSpace A]
    (f : C(A, X)) (a₀ : A) (H : Subgroup (_root_.FundamentalGroup X (f a₀))) :
    (_root_.FundamentalGroup.map f a₀).range ≤ H

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq_comp
decls.doc:
The maps induced on fundamental groups by two continuous maps compose to the map induced by
their composite: `mapOfEq g hg (mapOfEq f hf p) = mapOfEq (g.comp f) _ p`.
decls.statement:
theorem mapOfEq_comp (g : C(Y, Z)) (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) (hg : g y = z)
    (p : _root_.FundamentalGroup X x) :
    _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq g hg (_root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq f hf p) =
      _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq (g.comp f)
        (show (g.comp f) x = z by rw [ContinuousMap.comp_apply, hf, hg]) p

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq_id
decls.doc: The map induced on fundamental groups by the identity continuous map is the identity.
decls.statement:
theorem mapOfEq_id (h : (ContinuousMap.id X) x = x) (p : _root_.FundamentalGroup X x) :
    _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq (ContinuousMap.id X) h p = p

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq_congr
decls.doc:
The induced map `mapOfEq` depends only on the underlying continuous map, not on the chosen
proof of the basepoint equation: two equal continuous maps induce the same map.
decls.statement:
theorem mapOfEq_congr {f₁ f₂ : C(X, Y)} (hfe : f₁ = f₂) (h₁ : f₁ x = y) (h₂ : f₂ x = y)
    (p : _root_.FundamentalGroup X x) :
    _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq f₁ h₁ p = _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq f₂ h₂ p

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq_mapOfEq_of_comp_eq_id
decls.doc: If `g ∘ f` is the identity, then the induced map of `g` undoes the induced map of `f`.
decls.statement:
theorem mapOfEq_mapOfEq_of_comp_eq_id (g : C(Y, X)) (f : C(X, Y)) (hf : f x = y) (hg : g y = x)
    (hgf : g.comp f = ContinuousMap.id X) (p : _root_.FundamentalGroup X x) :
    _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq g hg (_root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq f hf p) = p

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquivOfEq
decls.doc:
A homeomorphism `e : X ≃ₜ Y` carrying `x` to `y` induces an isomorphism of fundamental groups
`π₁(X, x) ≃* π₁(Y, y)`. The forward map is `FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq` of `e`; the inverse is
`FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq` of `e.symm`.
decls.statement:
def homeomorphMulEquivOfEq (e : X ≃ₜ Y) (h : e x = y) :
    _root_.FundamentalGroup X x ≃* _root_.FundamentalGroup Y y

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquivOfEq_apply
decls.statement:
theorem homeomorphMulEquivOfEq_apply (e : X ≃ₜ Y) (h : e x = y)
    (p : _root_.FundamentalGroup X x) :
    homeomorphMulEquivOfEq e h p = _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨e, e.continuous⟩ h p

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquivOfEq_symm_apply
decls.statement:
theorem homeomorphMulEquivOfEq_symm_apply (e : X ≃ₜ Y) (h : e x = y)
    (q : _root_.FundamentalGroup Y y) :
    (homeomorphMulEquivOfEq e h).symm q =
      _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨e.symm, e.symm.continuous⟩
        (show e.symm y = x by rw [← h, e.symm_apply_apply]) q

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquiv
decls.doc:
A homeomorphism `e : X ≃ₜ Y` induces an isomorphism of fundamental groups
`π₁(X, x) ≃* π₁(Y, e x)`.
decls.statement:
def homeomorphMulEquiv (e : X ≃ₜ Y) (x : X) :
    _root_.FundamentalGroup X x ≃* _root_.FundamentalGroup Y (e x)

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquiv_apply
decls.statement:
theorem homeomorphMulEquiv_apply (e : X ≃ₜ Y) (x : X) (p : _root_.FundamentalGroup X x) :
    homeomorphMulEquiv e x p =
      _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨e, e.continuous⟩ rfl p

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.statement:
theorem homeomorphMulEquiv_symm_apply (e : X ≃ₜ Y) (x : X)
    (q : _root_.FundamentalGroup Y (e x)) :
    (homeomorphMulEquiv e x).symm q =
      _root_.FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq ⟨e.symm, e.symm.continuous⟩ (e.symm_apply_apply x) q

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The fundamental group of a binary product is the product of the fundamental groups:
`π₁(X × Y, (x, y)) ≃* π₁(X, x) × π₁(Y, y)`. The forward map is the pair of the maps induced
by the two coordinate projections; the inverse sends a pair of loop classes to their product
`Path.Homotopic.prod`.

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquiv_apply
decls.statement:
theorem FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquiv_apply (x : X) (y : Y)
    (γ : FundamentalGroup (X × Y) (x, y)) :
    FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquiv x y γ =
      (FundamentalGroup.map (ContinuousMap.fst : C(X × Y, X)) (x, y) γ,
        FundamentalGroup.map (ContinuousMap.snd : C(X × Y, Y)) (x, y) γ)

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.statement:
theorem FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquiv_symm_apply (x : X) (y : Y)
    (γ : FundamentalGroup X x × FundamentalGroup Y y) :
    (FundamentalGroup.prodMulEquiv x y).symm γ = prod γ.1 γ.2

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.piMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The fundamental group of an indexed product is the product of the fundamental groups:
`π₁(Π i, X i, x) ≃* Π i, π₁(X i, x i)`. The forward map records the loop's image under each
coordinate projection; the inverse assembles a loop from its coordinate loops via
`Path.Homotopic.pi`.
decls.statement:
def FundamentalGroup.piMulEquiv (x : ∀ i, X i) :
    FundamentalGroup (∀ i, X i) x ≃* ∀ i, FundamentalGroup (X i) (x i)

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.piMulEquiv_apply
decls.statement:
theorem FundamentalGroup.piMulEquiv_apply (x : ∀ i, X i)
    (γ : FundamentalGroup (∀ i, X i) x) (i : ι) :
    FundamentalGroup.piMulEquiv x γ i = FundamentalGroup.map (ContinuousMap.eval i) x γ

decls.name: TauCeti.FundamentalGroup.piMulEquiv_symm_apply
decls.statement:
theorem FundamentalGroup.piMulEquiv_symm_apply (x : ∀ i, X i)
    (γ : ∀ i, FundamentalGroup (X i) (x i)) :
    (FundamentalGroup.piMulEquiv x).symm γ = pi γ

decls.name: TauCeti.not_simplyConnectedSpace_of_nontrivial_fundamentalGroup
decls.doc:
A space with a nontrivial fundamental group at some basepoint is **not simply connected**: a
simply connected space has a subsingleton fundamental group.
decls.statement:
theorem not_simplyConnectedSpace_of_nontrivial_fundamentalGroup {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (x : X) [Nontrivial (FundamentalGroup X x)] : ¬ SimplyConnectedSpace X

decls.name: TauCeti.not_contractibleSpace_of_not_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
A **not simply connected** space is **not contractible**: a contractible space is simply
connected.
decls.statement:
theorem not_contractibleSpace_of_not_simplyConnectedSpace {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (h : ¬ SimplyConnectedSpace X) : ¬ ContractibleSpace X

decls.name: TauCeti.isEmpty_homeomorph_of_not_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
A **not simply connected** space is not homeomorphic to any simply connected space: a
homeomorphism is in particular a homotopy equivalence, and simple connectivity transfers along
homotopy equivalences.
decls.statement:
theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_of_not_simplyConnectedSpace {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (h : ¬ SimplyConnectedSpace X) (Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace Y] [SimplyConnectedSpace Y] :
    IsEmpty (X ≃ₜ Y)

decls.name: TauCeti.isEmpty_homeomorph_realTopologicalVectorSpace_of_not_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
A **not simply connected** space is not homeomorphic to any real topological vector space
(in particular, to any real normed space), since such a space is contractible, hence simply
connected.
decls.statement:
theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_realTopologicalVectorSpace_of_not_simplyConnectedSpace
    {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (h : ¬ SimplyConnectedSpace X) (E : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace E] [ContinuousAdd E] [ContinuousSMul ℝ E] :
    IsEmpty (X ≃ₜ E)

decls.name: TauCeti.isEmpty_homeomorph_real_of_not_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
A **not simply connected** space is not homeomorphic to the real line: `ℝ` is contractible,
hence simply connected.
decls.statement:
theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_real_of_not_simplyConnectedSpace {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (h : ¬ SimplyConnectedSpace X) : IsEmpty (X ≃ₜ ℝ)

decls.name: TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
A space is **semilocally simply connected** if every point `x` has a neighbourhood `U` such
that every loop in `U` based at `x` is null-homotopic in the whole space. The null-homotopy is
allowed to leave `U`, which is what makes this weaker than local simple connectivity.
decls.statement: class SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace (X : Type*) [TopologicalSpace X] : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace.exists_mem_nhds_subset_loops_nullhomotopic
decls.doc:
The witnessing neighbourhood of a point can be shrunk to lie inside any prescribed
neighbourhood: loops contained in a smaller set are in particular contained in the larger one.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_mem_nhds_subset_loops_nullhomotopic (x : X) {V : Set X} (hV : V ∈ 𝓝 x) :
    ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 x, U ⊆ V ∧ ∀ γ : Path x x, (∀ t, γ t ∈ U) → γ.Homotopic (Path.refl x)

decls.name: TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace.exists_isOpen_mem_nhds_subset_loops_nullhomotopic
decls.doc:
The witnessing neighbourhood can be taken open and inside any prescribed neighbourhood. This
is the form consumed by the universal-cover construction, where the sheets must be open.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_mem_nhds_subset_loops_nullhomotopic (x : X) {V : Set X} (hV : V ∈ 𝓝 x) :
    ∃ U, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ V ∧
      ∀ γ : Path x x, (∀ t, γ t ∈ U) → γ.Homotopic (Path.refl x)

decls.name: TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace.exists_isOpen_mem_nhds_loops_nullhomotopic
decls.doc:
The witnessing neighbourhood can be taken open. This is the form consumed by the
universal-cover construction, where the sheets must be open.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_mem_nhds_loops_nullhomotopic (x : X) :
    ∃ U, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ ∀ γ : Path x x, (∀ t, γ t ∈ U) → γ.Homotopic (Path.refl x)

decls.name: TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace.of_forall_exists_mem_nhds_isSimplyConnected
decls.doc:
If every point of `X` has a simply connected neighbourhood, then `X` is semilocally simply
connected: a loop inside such a neighbourhood is already null-homotopic there, hence in `X`.
decls.statement:
theorem SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace.of_forall_exists_mem_nhds_isSimplyConnected
    (h : ∀ x : X, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 x, IsSimplyConnected U) : SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X

decls.name: TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace.of_locallyContractibleSpace
decls.doc:
A locally contractible space (each neighbourhood of a point contains a smaller neighbourhood
whose inclusion into the larger one is null-homotopic) is semilocally simply connected. A based
loop in the smaller neighbourhood becomes null-homotopic once pushed forward along the
null-homotopic inclusion into `X`.
decls.statement:
theorem SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace.of_locallyContractibleSpace
    (h : LocallyContractibleSpace X) : SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X

decls.name: TauCeti.instSemilocallySimplyConnectedSpaceOfSimplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
A simply connected space is semilocally simply connected: the whole space already witnesses
the condition, since every loop is null-homotopic.
decls.statement: instance (priority := 100) [SimplyConnectedSpace X] : SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X

decls.name: TauCeti.instSemilocallySimplyConnectedSpaceOfStronglyLocallyContractibleSpace
decls.doc:
A strongly locally contractible space (each point has a basis of contractible neighbourhoods)
is semilocally simply connected, since strong local contractibility implies the classical local
contractibility hypothesis.
decls.statement:
instance (priority := 100) [StronglyLocallyContractibleSpace X] :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X

decls.name: TauCeti.instSemilocallySimplyConnectedSpaceOfDiscreteTopology
decls.doc:
A discrete space is semilocally simply connected: the singleton neighbourhood of a point
contains only the constant loop.
decls.statement: instance (priority := 100) [DiscreteTopology X] : SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X

decls.name: TauCeti.instSemilocallySimplyConnectedSpaceProd
decls.doc:
A product of semilocally simply connected spaces is semilocally simply connected: a loop in a
product of witnessing neighbourhoods projects to loops in each factor, and their null-homotopies
combine into a null-homotopy of the original loop.
decls.statement:
instance [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace Y] :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace (X × Y)

decls.name: SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt
decls.doc:
A space is semilocally simply connected at `x` if `x` has a neighborhood `U` such that
the map from `π₁(U, base)` to `π₁(X, base)` induced by the inclusion is trivial for all
basepoints in `U`. Equivalently, every loop in `U` is nullhomotopic in `X`.
decls.statement: def SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt (x : X) : Prop

decls.name: SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt.of_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc: Simply connected spaces are semilocally simply connected at every point.
decls.statement:
theorem SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt.of_simplyConnectedSpace
    [SimplyConnectedSpace X] (x : X) :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt x

decls.name: semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff
decls.doc:
Characterization of `SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt x` by open neighborhoods whose loops are
nullhomotopic in the ambient space.
decls.statement:
theorem semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff {x : X} :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt x ↔
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧
      ∀ {u : X} (γ : Path u u) (_ : range γ ⊆ U),
        Path.Homotopic γ (Path.refl u)

decls.name: semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff_paths
decls.doc:
Characterization of semilocally simply connected at a point: any two paths in U between
the same endpoints are homotopic.
decls.statement:
theorem semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff_paths {x : X} :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt x ↔
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧
      ∀ {u u' : X} (γ γ' : Path u u'),
        range γ ⊆ U → range γ' ⊆ U → γ.Homotopic γ'

decls.name: SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn
decls.doc:
A space is semilocally simply connected on `s` if it is semilocally simply connected
at every point of `s`.
decls.statement: def SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn (s : Set X) : Prop

decls.name: SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn.at
decls.doc:
Extract the pointwise `SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt x` statement from
`SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn s` and `x ∈ s`.
decls.statement:
theorem SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn.at (h : SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn s) (hx : x ∈ s) :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt x

decls.name: SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn.mono
decls.doc: Semilocal simple connectivity on a set restricts to any subset.
decls.statement:
theorem SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn.mono (h : SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn t)
    (hst : s ⊆ t) : SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn s

decls.name: IsPathHomotopyTrivial
decls.doc:
A subset `U` of a topological space `X` is *path-homotopy-trivial* if any two paths
in `X` whose images lie in `U` and which share endpoints are homotopic in `X`.
This is the form of "`U` is simply connected" used in the universal-cover
construction: it is weaker than `IsSimplyConnected U` because the homotopy is not required
to lie inside `U`.
decls.statement: def IsPathHomotopyTrivial (U : Set X) : Prop

decls.name: IsPathHomotopyTrivial.apply
decls.doc:
Apply path-homotopy triviality of `U` to compare two same-endpoint paths in `X` whose
ranges both lie in `U`.
decls.statement:
theorem IsPathHomotopyTrivial.apply {U : Set X} (hU : IsPathHomotopyTrivial U)
    ⦃a b : X⦄ (p q : Path a b) (hp : range p ⊆ U) (hq : range q ⊆ U) :
    Path.Homotopic p q

decls.name: semilocallySimplyConnectedOn_iff
decls.doc:
Set-level characterization of `SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn`: every point of `s` has an
open neighborhood in which every loop is nullhomotopic in the ambient space.
decls.statement:
theorem semilocallySimplyConnectedOn_iff :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn s ↔
    ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧
      ∀ {u : X} (γ : Path u u) (_ : range γ ⊆ U),
        Path.Homotopic γ (Path.refl u)

decls.name: semilocallySimplyConnectedOn_iff_paths
decls.doc:
Set-level path characterization of `SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn`: every point of `s` has an
open neighborhood in which same-endpoint paths with ranges in that neighborhood are homotopic in
the ambient space.
decls.statement:
theorem semilocallySimplyConnectedOn_iff_paths :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn s ↔
    ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧
      ∀ {u u' : X} (γ γ' : Path u u'),
        range γ ⊆ U → range γ' ⊆ U → γ.Homotopic γ'

decls.name: SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt.of_semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
On a locally path-connected space, the based class
`TauCeti.SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace` implies the unbased pointwise predicate
`SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt` at every point.
decls.statement:
theorem SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt.of_semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace
    [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (x : X) :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt x

decls.name: SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn.of_semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
On a locally path-connected semilocally simply connected space, every subset is pointwise
semilocally simply connected.
decls.statement:
theorem SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn.of_semilocallySimplyConnectedSpace
    [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (s : Set X) :
    SemilocallySimplyConnectedOn s

decls.name: SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt.exists_isOpen_mem_isPathHomotopyTrivial
decls.doc:
In an SLSC space, every point has an open neighborhood `U` with the
`IsPathHomotopyTrivial U` property: any two paths in `U` with the same endpoints are
homotopic (so path homotopy classes are determined by endpoints).

This is `semilocallySimplyConnectedAt_iff_paths.mp` repackaged with the
`IsPathHomotopyTrivial` abstraction, which is the form most downstream users consume.

decls.name: exists_isOpen_mem_isPathHomotopyTrivial
decls.doc:
In a locally path-connected semilocally simply connected space, every point has an open
path-homotopy-trivial neighborhood.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_mem_isPathHomotopyTrivial
    [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (x : X) :
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ IsPathHomotopyTrivial U

decls.name: SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt.exists_isOpen_mem_isPathConnected_isPathHomotopyTrivial
decls.doc:
An SLSC neighborhood can be chosen to be path-connected. In a locally path-connected space,
we can use the path component of x in an SLSC neighborhood V to get a neighborhood that is both
open, path-connected, and has the SLSC property (paths with same endpoints in U are homotopic).
decls.statement:
theorem SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt.exists_isOpen_mem_isPathConnected_isPathHomotopyTrivial
    [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] {x : X} (h : SemilocallySimplyConnectedAt x) :
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ IsPathConnected U ∧ IsPathHomotopyTrivial U

decls.name: exists_isOpen_mem_isPathConnected_isPathHomotopyTrivial
decls.doc:
In a locally path-connected semilocally simply connected space, every point has an open,
path-connected, path-homotopy-trivial neighborhood.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_isOpen_mem_isPathConnected_isPathHomotopyTrivial
    [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] (x : X) :
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ IsPathConnected U ∧ IsPathHomotopyTrivial U

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.Face
decls.doc: A face of an abstract simplicial complex, bundled with its membership proof.
decls.statement: abbrev Face {ι : Type*} (K : AbstractSimplicialComplex ι)

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex
decls.doc:
A finite set is a face of the underlying precomplex exactly when it is a face of the abstract
simplicial complex itself. This is the single place where the two `SetLike` instances are
identified.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex {ι : Type*} {K : AbstractSimplicialComplex ι}
    {σ : Finset ι} : σ ∈ K.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex ↔ σ ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.point
decls.doc: The one-vertex complex at `v`.  Its unique face is `{v}`.
decls.statement: def point (v : ι) : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_point
decls.statement: theorem mem_point {v : ι} {σ : Finset ι} : σ ∈ point v ↔ σ = {v}

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.singleton_mem_point
decls.doc: A singleton is a face of `point v` exactly when it is the singleton at `v`.
decls.statement: theorem singleton_mem_point {v w : ι} : {w} ∈ point v ↔ w = v

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.point_le_iff
decls.doc: The one-vertex complex at `v` is a subcomplex of `K` exactly when `{v}` is a face of `K`.
decls.statement:
theorem point_le_iff {v : ι} {K : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι} :
    point v ≤ K ↔ ({v} : Finset ι) ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.point_ne_bot
decls.doc: The one-vertex complex at `v` is nonempty.
decls.statement: theorem point_ne_bot (v : ι) : point v ≠ ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.point_inj
decls.doc: Two one-vertex complexes are equal exactly when their vertices are equal.
decls.statement: theorem point_inj {v w : ι} : point v = point w ↔ v = w

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.simplex_singleton
decls.doc: The abstract simplex spanned by a single vertex is the one-vertex complex at that vertex.
decls.statement: theorem simplex_singleton (v : ι) : simplex {v} = point v

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo
decls.doc:
`K` collapses to `L` when a finite, possibly empty, sequence of elementary collapses takes
`K` to `L`.
decls.statement: def CollapsesTo (K L : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.refl
decls.doc: Every complex collapses to itself by the empty sequence.
decls.statement: theorem refl (K : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) : CollapsesTo K K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.single
decls.doc: An elementary collapse is a collapse of length one.
decls.statement: theorem single (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) : CollapsesTo K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.trans
decls.doc: Collapse is transitive by concatenating finite collapse sequences.
decls.statement: theorem trans (hKL : CollapsesTo K L) (hLP : CollapsesTo L P) : CollapsesTo K P

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.head
decls.doc: Prepending an elementary collapse to a collapse sequence gives a collapse.
decls.statement: theorem head (hKL : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) (hLP : CollapsesTo L P) : CollapsesTo K P

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.tail
decls.doc: Appending an elementary collapse to a collapse sequence gives a collapse.
decls.statement: theorem tail (hKL : CollapsesTo K L) (hLP : ElementaryCollapsesTo L P) : CollapsesTo K P

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.le
decls.doc: The endpoint of a collapse is a subcomplex of its starting complex.
decls.statement: theorem le (h : CollapsesTo K L) : L ≤ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.eq_of_le
decls.doc: If `K` collapses to a complex `L` that contains `K`, then `K` and `L` are equal.
decls.statement: theorem eq_of_le (h : CollapsesTo K L) (hKL : K ≤ L) : K = L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.antisymm
decls.doc: A collapse between comparable complexes is equality when the order points both ways.
decls.statement: theorem antisymm (hKL : CollapsesTo K L) (hLK : CollapsesTo L K) : K = L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.eq_or_exists_head
decls.doc: A nontrivial collapse sequence contains a first elementary collapse.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_or_exists_head (h : CollapsesTo K L) :
    K = L ∨ ∃ P, ElementaryCollapsesTo K P ∧ CollapsesTo P L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.lt
decls.doc: A nontrivial collapse strictly decreases the complex.
decls.statement: theorem lt (h : CollapsesTo K L) (hne : K ≠ L) : L < K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.property_of_antitone
decls.doc: A collapse preserves any property that is inherited by subcomplexes.
decls.statement:
theorem property_of_antitone {p : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι → Prop}
    (hp : ∀ ⦃A B⦄, A ≤ B → p B → p A) (h : CollapsesTo K L) (hK : p K) : p L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.property_of_elementaryCollapsesTo
decls.doc: A property preserved by each elementary collapse is preserved by a collapse sequence.
decls.statement:
theorem property_of_elementaryCollapsesTo
    {p : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι → Prop}
    (hp : ∀ ⦃A B⦄, ElementaryCollapsesTo A B → p A → p B)
    (h : CollapsesTo K L) (hK : p K) : p L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Collapsible
decls.doc: A simplicial complex is collapsible when it collapses to a one-vertex complex.
decls.statement: def Collapsible (K : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.collapsible_iff
decls.doc:
A complex is collapsible exactly when it admits a collapse sequence to some one-vertex
complex.
decls.statement:
theorem collapsible_iff {K : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι} :
    Collapsible K ↔ ∃ v : ι, CollapsesTo K (point v)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Collapsible.point
decls.doc: A one-vertex complex is collapsible, using the empty collapse sequence.
decls.statement: theorem point (v : ι) : Collapsible (point v)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Collapsible.of_collapsesTo
decls.doc: If `K` collapses to a collapsible complex, then `K` is collapsible.
decls.statement: theorem of_collapsesTo (hKL : CollapsesTo K L) (hL : Collapsible L) : Collapsible K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Collapsible.of_elementaryCollapsesTo
decls.doc: If `K` elementarily collapses to a collapsible complex, then `K` is collapsible.
decls.statement:
theorem of_elementaryCollapsesTo (hKL : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) (hL : Collapsible L) :
    Collapsible K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Collapsible.ne_bot
decls.doc: A collapsible complex is nonempty.
decls.statement: theorem ne_bot (h : Collapsible K) : K ≠ ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Collapsible.exists_vertex
decls.doc: A collapsible complex contains its terminal vertex as a face.
decls.statement: theorem exists_vertex (h : Collapsible K) : ∃ v : ι, ({v} : Finset ι) ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsCone.isFreePair
decls.doc:
In a cone, a face `σ` missing the apex and maximal with that property is a free face, with
`insert v σ` as its unique proper coface.

Maximality is used twice: a coface of `σ` missing the apex is `σ` itself, and a coface `ω`
containing the apex has `ω.erase v` a coface of `σ` missing the apex, hence equal to `σ`.
decls.statement:
theorem IsCone.isFreePair (h : IsCone K v) (hσ : σ ∈ K) (hv : v ∉ σ)
    (hmax : ∀ ⦃τ : Finset ι⦄, τ ∈ K → v ∉ τ → σ ⊆ τ → τ = σ) :
    IsFreePair K σ (insert v σ)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.exists_maximal_notMem_of_mem
decls.doc:
A finite complex with a face missing `v` has one that is maximal among the faces missing
`v`.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_maximal_notMem_of_mem (hfin : K.faces.Finite) (hσ : σ ∈ K) (hv : v ∉ σ) :
    ∃ τ ∈ K, v ∉ τ ∧ ∀ ⦃ω : Finset ι⦄, ω ∈ K → v ∉ ω → τ ⊆ ω → ω = τ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsCone.exists_notMem_of_ne_point
decls.doc: A cone with apex `v` that is not the one-vertex complex at `v` has a face missing `v`.
decls.statement:
theorem IsCone.exists_notMem_of_ne_point (h : IsCone K v) (hne : K ≠ point v) :
    ∃ σ ∈ K, v ∉ σ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.collapsesTo_point_aux
decls.doc:
The collapse of a finite cone to its apex, by induction on a bound for the face count: each
elementary collapse removes a maximal apex-free face together with its unique coface, and leaves
a cone with the same apex.
decls.statement:
theorem collapsesTo_point_aux (v : ι) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι), K.faces.Finite →
      K.faces.ncard ≤ n → IsCone K v → CollapsesTo K (point v)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsCone.collapsesTo_point
decls.doc:
**A finite cone collapses to its apex** (Rourke--Sanderson, *Introduction to
Piecewise-Linear Topology*, Chapter 3).
decls.title: A finite cone collapses to its apex
decls.statement:
theorem IsCone.collapsesTo_point (h : IsCone K v) (hfin : K.faces.Finite) :
    CollapsesTo K (point v)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsCone.collapsible
decls.doc: A finite cone is collapsible.
decls.statement: theorem IsCone.collapsible (h : IsCone K v) (hfin : K.faces.Finite) : Collapsible K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.collapsesTo_point_simplex
decls.doc: An abstract simplex collapses to any of its vertices.
decls.statement: theorem collapsesTo_point_simplex (hv : v ∈ V) : CollapsesTo (simplex V) (point v)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.collapsible_simplex
decls.doc:
An abstract simplex on a nonempty spanning set is collapsible.  Its face count grows with
the spanning set, so this exhibits collapsible complexes with arbitrarily many faces, beyond the
one-vertex complexes of `Collapsible.point`.
decls.statement: theorem collapsible_simplex (hV : V.Nonempty) : Collapsible (simplex V)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.collapsesTo_point_closedStar
decls.doc: A finite closed star of a face collapses to any vertex of that face.
decls.statement:
theorem collapsesTo_point_closedStar (hfin : (closedStar K σ).faces.Finite) (hσ : σ ∈ K)
    (hv : v ∈ σ) : CollapsesTo (closedStar K σ) (point v)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.collapsible_closedStar
decls.doc: A finite closed star of a face is collapsible.
decls.statement:
theorem collapsible_closedStar (hfin : (closedStar K σ).faces.Finite) (hσ : σ ∈ K) :
    Collapsible (closedStar K σ)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.collapsesTo_point_cone
decls.doc: The cone on a finite complex collapses to its apex.
decls.statement:
theorem collapsesTo_point_cone (hfin : L.faces.Finite) :
    CollapsesTo (cone L) (point (Sum.inr PUnit.unit))

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.collapsible_cone
decls.doc: The cone on a finite complex is collapsible.
decls.statement: theorem collapsible_cone (hfin : L.faces.Finite) : Collapsible (cone L)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.encard_faces_add_two
decls.doc: An elementary collapse removes exactly two faces.
decls.statement:
theorem encard_faces_add_two (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) :
    L.faces.encard + 2 = K.faces.encard

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.ncard_faces_add_two
decls.doc: An elementary collapse of a finite complex removes exactly two faces.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_faces_add_two (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) (hK : K.faces.Finite) :
    Set.ncard L.faces + 2 = Set.ncard K.faces

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.ncard_faces_eq_sub_two
decls.doc: The face count after an elementary collapse is the original face count minus two.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_faces_eq_sub_two (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) (hK : K.faces.Finite) :
    Set.ncard L.faces = Set.ncard K.faces - 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.ncard_faces_lt
decls.doc: An elementary collapse strictly decreases the number of faces of a finite complex.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_faces_lt (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) (hK : K.faces.Finite) :
    Set.ncard L.faces < Set.ncard K.faces

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.ncard_faces_mod_two
decls.doc: An elementary collapse preserves the parity of the number of faces.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_faces_mod_two (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) (hK : K.faces.Finite) :
    Set.ncard L.faces % 2 = Set.ncard K.faces % 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.encard_faces_le
decls.doc: A collapse can only decrease the face cardinality.
decls.statement: theorem encard_faces_le (h : CollapsesTo K L) : L.faces.encard ≤ K.faces.encard

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.ncard_faces_le
decls.doc: A collapse of a finite complex can only decrease its number of faces.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_faces_le (h : CollapsesTo K L) (hK : K.faces.Finite) :
    Set.ncard L.faces ≤ Set.ncard K.faces

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.ncard_faces_mod_two
decls.doc: A collapse of a finite complex preserves the parity of its number of faces.
decls.statement:
theorem ncard_faces_mod_two (h : CollapsesTo K L) (hK : K.faces.Finite) :
    Set.ncard L.faces % 2 = Set.ncard K.faces % 2

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_map_iff
decls.statement:
theorem mem_map_iff {f : α → β} {K : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α}
    {σ : Finset β} : σ ∈ K.map f ↔ ∃ τ, τ ∈ K ∧ τ.image f = σ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map_injective
decls.statement:
theorem map_injective (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Function.Injective (fun K : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α => K.map f)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map_point
decls.doc:
Mapping a one-vertex complex along any vertex map gives the one-vertex complex at the image
vertex.
decls.statement: theorem map_point (f : α → β) (v : α) : (point v).map f = point (f v)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map_deletion
decls.doc:
An injective vertex map commutes with deletion: a face contains the image of `σ` exactly when
its unique preimage face contains `σ`.
decls.statement:
theorem map_deletion (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α)
    (σ : Finset α) : (deletion K σ).map f = deletion (K.map f) (σ.image f)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsFreePair.map
decls.doc:
An injective relabeling of the vertices of a complex carries a free pair to a free pair in
the image complex.
decls.statement:
theorem map (h : IsFreePair K σ τ) (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    IsFreePair (K.map f) (σ.image f) (τ.image f)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsFreePair.map_iff_of_injective
decls.doc: An injective relabeling preserves and reflects a free pair.
decls.statement:
theorem map_iff_of_injective (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    IsFreePair (K.map f) (σ.image f) (τ.image f) ↔ IsFreePair K σ τ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.map
decls.doc:
An injective relabeling preserves an elementary collapse. The deleted free pair is sent to
its image pair.
decls.statement:
theorem map (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    ElementaryCollapsesTo (K.map f) (L.map f)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.exists_of_map_left
decls.statement:
theorem exists_of_map_left {P : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex β}
    {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Injective f) (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo (K.map f) P) :
    ∃ L : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α,
      P = L.map f ∧ ElementaryCollapsesTo K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.map_iff_of_injective
decls.doc: An injective relabeling preserves and reflects an elementary collapse.
decls.statement:
theorem map_iff_of_injective (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    ElementaryCollapsesTo (K.map f) (L.map f) ↔ ElementaryCollapsesTo K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.map
decls.doc:
An injective relabeling carries every finite collapse sequence to the corresponding sequence
between the image complexes.
decls.statement:
theorem map (h : CollapsesTo K L) (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    CollapsesTo (K.map f) (L.map f)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.map_iff_of_injective
decls.doc: An injective relabeling preserves and reflects finite collapse sequences.
decls.statement:
theorem map_iff_of_injective (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    CollapsesTo (K.map f) (L.map f) ↔ CollapsesTo K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.CollapsesTo.map_equiv_iff
decls.doc:
Relabeling both complexes by a vertex equivalence preserves and reflects the existence of a
finite collapse sequence.
decls.statement:
theorem map_equiv_iff (e : α ≃ β) :
    CollapsesTo (K.map e) (L.map e) ↔ CollapsesTo K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Collapsible.map
decls.doc:
An injective relabeling preserves collapsibility, with the image of a terminal vertex as the
terminal vertex of the image collapse.
decls.statement:
theorem map (h : Collapsible K) (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Collapsible (K.map f)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Collapsible.map_iff_of_injective
decls.doc: An injective relabeling preserves and reflects collapsibility.
decls.statement:
theorem map_iff_of_injective (f : α → β) (hf : Function.Injective f) :
    Collapsible (K.map f) ↔ Collapsible K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.Collapsible.map_equiv_iff
decls.doc: Relabeling a complex by a vertex equivalence preserves and reflects collapsibility.
decls.statement: theorem map_equiv_iff (e : α ≃ β) : Collapsible (K.map e) ↔ Collapsible K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.cone
decls.doc:
The cone on a pre-abstract simplicial complex, defined as its join with the full complex on
the one-point type `PUnit`.
decls.statement:
def cone (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α) :
    PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (α ⊕ PUnit)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_cone_iff
decls.doc:
A finite set is a face of the cone exactly when it is nonempty and its left projection is
either empty or a face of the base complex.  There is no further condition on the right
projection because the apex type has one element.

This is a low-priority `simp` lemma: it normalizes membership of an arbitrary finite set, while
the specialized characterizations below still fire first on their own shapes.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_cone_iff {σ : Finset (α ⊕ PUnit)} :
    σ ∈ cone K ↔ σ.Nonempty ∧ (σ.toLeft = ∅ ∨ σ.toLeft ∈ K)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map_inl_mem_cone_iff
decls.doc:
A finite set tagged into the left summand is a face of the cone exactly when it is a face of
the base complex.
decls.statement:
theorem map_inl_mem_cone_iff {s : Finset α} :
    s.map (Embedding.inl : α ↪ α ⊕ PUnit) ∈ cone K ↔ s ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map_inl_mem_cone
decls.doc: Every face of the base complex, tagged into the left summand, is a face of its cone.
decls.statement:
theorem map_inl_mem_cone {s : Finset α} (hs : s ∈ K) :
    s.map (Embedding.inl : α ↪ α ⊕ PUnit) ∈ cone K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.apex_mem_cone
decls.doc: The cone apex is a face.
decls.statement: theorem apex_mem_cone : ({Sum.inr PUnit.unit} : Finset (α ⊕ PUnit)) ∈ cone K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.disjSum_singleton_mem_cone_iff
decls.doc:
Adjoining the apex gives a face of the cone exactly when the base is empty or a face of the
base complex.
decls.statement:
theorem disjSum_singleton_mem_cone_iff {s : Finset α} :
    s.disjSum {PUnit.unit} ∈ cone K ↔ s = ∅ ∨ s ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.disjSum_singleton_mem_cone
decls.doc: Adjoining the apex to a face of the base produces a face of the cone.
decls.statement:
theorem disjSum_singleton_mem_cone {s : Finset α} (hs : s ∈ K) :
    s.disjSum {PUnit.unit} ∈ cone K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.cone_mono
decls.doc: Coning is monotone in the base complex.
decls.statement: theorem cone_mono (h : K ≤ L) : cone K ≤ cone L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.finite_faces_cone
decls.doc:
The cone on a finite complex is finite: a face of the cone is determined by its two
projections (`Finset.sumEquiv`), the left one is empty or a face of the base, and the apex type
is finite.
decls.statement: theorem finite_faces_cone (hfin : K.faces.Finite) : (cone K).faces.Finite

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.isCone_cone
decls.doc:
The cone construction produces a cone in the internal sense, with apex the adjoined
vertex.  This is what identifies the two accounts of a cone.
decls.statement:
theorem isCone_cone [DecidableEq α] (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α) :
    IsCone (cone K) (Sum.inr PUnit.unit)

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.cone
decls.doc:
The cone on an abstract simplicial complex, defined as its join with the full complex on the
one-point type `PUnit`.
decls.statement:
def cone (K : AbstractSimplicialComplex α) :
    AbstractSimplicialComplex (α ⊕ PUnit)

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.cone_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex
decls.doc:
Forgetting the singleton-face witness from an abstract cone recovers the cone of the
underlying pre-abstract simplicial complex.
decls.statement:
theorem cone_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex :
    (cone K).toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex =
      PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.cone K.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_cone_iff
decls.doc:
A finite set is a face of the cone exactly when it is nonempty and its left projection is
either empty or a face of the base complex.

This is a low-priority `simp` lemma: it normalizes membership of an arbitrary finite set, while
the specialized characterizations below still fire first on their own shapes.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_cone_iff {σ : Finset (α ⊕ PUnit)} :
    σ ∈ cone K ↔ σ.Nonempty ∧ (σ.toLeft = ∅ ∨ σ.toLeft ∈ K)

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.map_inl_mem_cone_iff
decls.doc:
A finite set tagged into the left summand is a face of the cone exactly when it is a face of
the base complex.
decls.statement:
theorem map_inl_mem_cone_iff {s : Finset α} :
    s.map (Embedding.inl : α ↪ α ⊕ PUnit) ∈ cone K ↔ s ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.map_inl_mem_cone
decls.doc: Every face of the base complex, tagged into the left summand, is a face of its cone.
decls.statement:
theorem map_inl_mem_cone {s : Finset α} (hs : s ∈ K) :
    s.map (Embedding.inl : α ↪ α ⊕ PUnit) ∈ cone K

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.apex_mem_cone
decls.doc: The cone apex is a face.
decls.statement: theorem apex_mem_cone : ({Sum.inr PUnit.unit} : Finset (α ⊕ PUnit)) ∈ cone K

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.disjSum_singleton_mem_cone_iff
decls.doc:
Adjoining the apex gives a face of the cone exactly when the base is empty or a face of the
base complex.
decls.statement:
theorem disjSum_singleton_mem_cone_iff {s : Finset α} :
    s.disjSum {PUnit.unit} ∈ cone K ↔ s = ∅ ∨ s ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.disjSum_singleton_mem_cone
decls.doc: Adjoining the apex to a face of the base produces a face of the cone.
decls.statement:
theorem disjSum_singleton_mem_cone {s : Finset α} (hs : s ∈ K) :
    s.disjSum {PUnit.unit} ∈ cone K

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.cone_mono
decls.doc: Coning is monotone in the base complex.
decls.statement: theorem cone_mono (h : K ≤ L) : cone K ≤ cone L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension
decls.doc:
The **dimension** of a pre-abstract simplicial complex: the supremum, over its faces `σ`, of
the face dimension `σ.card - 1`. It takes values in `WithBot ℕ∞`, so the void complex has dimension
`⊥` and an unbounded complex has dimension `⊤`.
decls.statement: def dimension (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) : WithBot ℕ∞

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.le_dimension
decls.doc: The dimension of any face bounds the dimension of the complex.
decls.statement: theorem le_dimension (hσ : σ ∈ K) : ((σ.card - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ dimension K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension_le_iff
decls.doc: The dimension of a complex is bounded by `n` exactly when every face's dimension is.
decls.statement:
theorem dimension_le_iff {n : WithBot ℕ∞} :
    dimension K ≤ n ↔ ∀ σ ∈ K, ((σ.card - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ n

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension_mono
decls.doc: Dimension is monotone in the complex.
decls.statement: theorem dimension_mono (h : K ≤ L) : dimension K ≤ dimension L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension_bot
decls.doc: The void complex has dimension `⊥`.
decls.statement: theorem dimension_bot : dimension (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension_eq_bot_iff
decls.doc: Only the void complex has dimension `⊥`: any face contributes a nonnegative dimension.
decls.statement: theorem dimension_eq_bot_iff : dimension K = ⊥ ↔ K = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension_simplex
decls.doc: The dimension of the standard simplex on a nonempty vertex set `V` is `V.card - 1`.
decls.statement:
theorem dimension_simplex {V : Finset ι} (hV : V.Nonempty) :
    dimension (simplex V) = ((V.card - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension_simplexBoundary
decls.doc:
The dimension of the boundary of the standard simplex on a vertex set `V` with at least two
vertices is `V.card - 2`.
decls.statement:
theorem dimension_simplexBoundary {V : Finset ι} (hV : 1 < V.card) :
    dimension (simplexBoundary V) = ((V.card - 2 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension
decls.doc:
The **dimension** of an abstract simplicial complex, defined through its underlying
precomplex.
decls.statement: def dimension (K : AbstractSimplicialComplex ι) : WithBot ℕ∞

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex
decls.doc: The dimension of an abstract complex agrees with the dimension of its underlying precomplex.
decls.statement:
theorem dimension_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex (K : AbstractSimplicialComplex ι) :
    PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension K.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex = dimension K

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.le_dimension
decls.doc: The dimension of any face bounds the dimension of the complex.
decls.statement: theorem le_dimension (hσ : σ ∈ K) : ((σ.card - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ dimension K

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension_le_iff
decls.doc: The dimension of an abstract complex is bounded by `n` exactly when every face's dimension is.
decls.statement:
theorem dimension_le_iff {n : WithBot ℕ∞} :
    dimension K ≤ n ↔ ∀ σ ∈ K, ((σ.card - 1 : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ≤ n

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.dimension_mono
decls.doc: Dimension is monotone in the abstract complex.
decls.statement: theorem dimension_mono (h : K ≤ L) : dimension K ≤ dimension L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsFreePair
decls.doc:
A pair `(σ, τ)` of faces is free when `σ` is a proper face of `τ` and `τ` is the only
face other than `σ` that contains `σ`.

This formulation includes maximality of `τ`: applying the last field to a face containing `τ`
forces that face to equal `τ`.
decls.statement: structure IsFreePair (σ τ : Finset ι) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsFreePair.upper_maximal
decls.doc: The upper face of a free pair is maximal in the complex.
decls.statement:
theorem upper_maximal (h : IsFreePair K σ τ) {ω : Finset ι} (hω : ω ∈ K) (hτω : τ ⊆ ω) :
    ω = τ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsFreePair.covBy
decls.doc: The lower face of a free pair has codimension one in the upper face.
decls.statement: theorem covBy (h : IsFreePair K σ τ) : σ ⋖ τ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_deletion_of_isFreePair
decls.doc:
Deleting the lower face of a free pair retains exactly the original faces other than the
lower and upper faces.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_deletion_of_isFreePair {σ τ ω : Finset ι} (h : IsFreePair K σ τ) :
    (ω ∈ K ∧ ¬σ ⊆ ω) ↔ ω ∈ K ∧ ω ≠ σ ∧ ω ≠ τ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo
decls.doc:
One complex elementarily collapses to another when the latter is obtained by deleting a
free pair.
decls.statement: def ElementaryCollapsesTo (L : _root_.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.of_isFreePair
decls.doc: A free pair determines an elementary collapse to its deletion.
decls.statement:
theorem of_isFreePair {σ τ : Finset ι} (hfree : IsFreePair K σ τ)
    (hL : L = deletion K σ) : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.le
decls.doc: An elementary collapse produces a subcomplex.
decls.statement: theorem le (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) : L ≤ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.lt
decls.doc: An elementary collapse is strict: its lower free face is lost.
decls.statement: theorem lt (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) : L < K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ElementaryCollapsesTo.exists_pair
decls.doc:
Membership in the result of an elementary collapse is membership in the original complex
away from the selected free pair.
decls.statement:
theorem exists_pair (h : ElementaryCollapsesTo K L) :
    ∃ (σ τ : Finset ι) (_hfree : IsFreePair K σ τ), σ ⋖ τ ∧
      ∀ ω, ω ∈ L ↔ ω ∈ K ∧ ω ≠ σ ∧ ω ≠ τ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsCone
decls.doc:
`K` is a **cone with apex `v`** when `v` is a vertex of `K` and adjoining `v` to a face of
`K` again gives a face of `K`.

This is the internal form of the cone condition: the apex is a vertex of the ambient type of
`K` itself, so a complex can be recognised as a cone without changing its vertex type.  The
`cone` construction satisfies it at its apex (`isCone_cone`).
decls.statement: structure IsCone (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι) (v : ι) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.IsCone.ne_bot
decls.doc: A cone with apex `v` is nonempty.
decls.statement: theorem IsCone.ne_bot {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι} (h : IsCone K v) : K ≠ ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.join
decls.doc:
The join of two pre-abstract simplicial complexes, on the disjoint sum of their vertex types.
A nonempty finite set is a face when each of its nonempty left and right projections is a face of
the corresponding complex.

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_join_iff
decls.doc:
Membership in a precomplex join is equivalent to nonemptiness together with the left and
right projection face conditions.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_join_iff {σ : Finset (α ⊕ β)} :
    σ ∈ join K L ↔ σ.Nonempty ∧
      (σ.toLeft = ∅ ∨ σ.toLeft ∈ K) ∧ (σ.toRight = ∅ ∨ σ.toRight ∈ L)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.disjSum_mem_join_iff
decls.doc:
A disjoint union is a face of the join exactly when it is nonempty and each nonempty
component is a face of its original complex.
decls.statement:
theorem disjSum_mem_join_iff {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} :
    s.disjSum t ∈ join K L ↔
      (s.Nonempty ∨ t.Nonempty) ∧ (s = ∅ ∨ s ∈ K) ∧ (t = ∅ ∨ t ∈ L)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map_inl_mem_join
decls.doc: A left face, tagged into the sum type, is a face of the join.
decls.statement:
theorem map_inl_mem_join {s : Finset α} (hs : s ∈ K) :
    s.map (Embedding.inl : α ↪ α ⊕ β) ∈ join K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map_inr_mem_join
decls.doc: A right face, tagged into the sum type, is a face of the join.
decls.statement:
theorem map_inr_mem_join {t : Finset β} (ht : t ∈ L) :
    t.map (Embedding.inr : β ↪ α ⊕ β) ∈ join K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.disjSum_mem_join
decls.doc: The disjoint union of a left face and a right face is a face of the join.
decls.statement:
theorem disjSum_mem_join {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} (hs : s ∈ K) (ht : t ∈ L) :
    s.disjSum t ∈ join K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.join_mono
decls.doc: Join is monotone in both complexes.
decls.statement: theorem join_mono (hK : K ≤ K') (hL : L ≤ L') : join K L ≤ join K' L'

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.join
decls.doc: The join of two abstract simplicial complexes, with vertices in the disjoint sum.
decls.statement:
def join (K : AbstractSimplicialComplex α) (L : AbstractSimplicialComplex β) :
    AbstractSimplicialComplex (α ⊕ β)

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.join_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex
decls.doc: Forgetting that the join contains every singleton recovers the underlying precomplex join.
decls.statement:
theorem join_toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex :
    (join K L).toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex =
      PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.join K.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex
        L.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_join_iff
decls.doc:
Membership in an abstract join is equivalent to nonemptiness together with the left and
right projection face conditions.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_join_iff {σ : Finset (α ⊕ β)} :
    σ ∈ join K L ↔ σ.Nonempty ∧
      (σ.toLeft = ∅ ∨ σ.toLeft ∈ K) ∧ (σ.toRight = ∅ ∨ σ.toRight ∈ L)

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.disjSum_mem_join_iff
decls.doc:
A disjoint union is a face of the abstract join exactly when it is nonempty and each
nonempty component is a face of its original complex.
decls.statement:
theorem disjSum_mem_join_iff {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} :
    s.disjSum t ∈ join K L ↔
      (s.Nonempty ∨ t.Nonempty) ∧ (s = ∅ ∨ s ∈ K) ∧ (t = ∅ ∨ t ∈ L)

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.map_inl_mem_join
decls.doc: A left face, tagged into the sum type, is a face of the join.
decls.statement:
theorem map_inl_mem_join {s : Finset α} (hs : s ∈ K) :
    s.map (Embedding.inl : α ↪ α ⊕ β) ∈ join K L

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.map_inr_mem_join
decls.doc: A right face, tagged into the sum type, is a face of the join.
decls.statement:
theorem map_inr_mem_join {t : Finset β} (ht : t ∈ L) :
    t.map (Embedding.inr : β ↪ α ⊕ β) ∈ join K L

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.disjSum_mem_join
decls.doc: The disjoint union of faces is a face of the join.
decls.statement:
theorem disjSum_mem_join {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} (hs : s ∈ K) (ht : t ∈ L) :
    s.disjSum t ∈ join K L

decls.name: TauCeti.AbstractSimplicialComplex.join_mono
decls.doc: Join is monotone in both abstract simplicial complexes.
decls.statement:
theorem join_mono (hK : K ≤ K') (hL : L ≤ L') :
    join K L ≤ join K' L'

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.closedStar
decls.doc:
The **closed star** of a simplex `σ` in `K`: the faces `ρ` whose union with `σ` is a face of
`K`. Equivalently, this is the subcomplex of `K` generated by faces whose union with `σ` remains
in `K`.
decls.statement: def closedStar : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.link
decls.doc:
The **link** of a simplex `σ` in `K`: the part of the closed star disjoint from `σ`, i.e. the
faces `ρ` disjoint from `σ` with `ρ ∪ σ` a face of `K`. This is the primitive the combinatorial
`n`-manifold condition is phrased against: the link of every vertex should be a combinatorial
sphere or ball.
decls.statement: def link : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.deletion
decls.doc:
The **deletion** (or *anti-star*) of a simplex `σ` in `K`: the faces of `K` that do not contain
`σ` as a subset. Together with the closed star it covers `K` (`closedStar_sup_deletion`).
decls.statement: def deletion : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ι

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_closedStar
decls.statement: theorem mem_closedStar {ρ : Finset ι} : ρ ∈ closedStar K σ ↔ ρ.Nonempty ∧ ρ ∪ σ ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_link
decls.statement:
theorem mem_link {ρ : Finset ι} :
    ρ ∈ link K σ ↔ ρ.Nonempty ∧ Disjoint ρ σ ∧ ρ ∪ σ ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_deletion
decls.statement: theorem mem_deletion {ρ : Finset ι} : ρ ∈ deletion K σ ↔ ρ ∈ K ∧ ¬ σ ⊆ ρ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_closedStar_iff
decls.doc: Membership in the closed star, with the underlying `K`-face exposed.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_closedStar_iff {ρ : Finset ι} :
    ρ ∈ closedStar K σ ↔ ρ ∈ K ∧ ρ ∪ σ ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_link_iff
decls.doc: Membership in the link, with the underlying `K`-face exposed.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_link_iff {ρ : Finset ι} :
    ρ ∈ link K σ ↔ ρ ∈ K ∧ Disjoint ρ σ ∧ ρ ∪ σ ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.closedStar_le
decls.doc: The closed star of `σ` is a subcomplex of `K`.
decls.statement: theorem closedStar_le : closedStar K σ ≤ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.link_le_closedStar
decls.doc: The link of `σ` is a subcomplex of its closed star.
decls.statement: theorem link_le_closedStar : link K σ ≤ closedStar K σ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.link_le
decls.doc: The link of `σ` is a subcomplex of `K`.
decls.statement: theorem link_le : link K σ ≤ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.deletion_le
decls.doc: The deletion of `σ` is a subcomplex of `K`.
decls.statement: theorem deletion_le : deletion K σ ≤ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.closedStar_sup_deletion
decls.doc:
The closed star and the deletion of `σ` cover `K`: every face either survives in the deletion
(it does not contain `σ`) or lies in the closed star (it, hence its union with `σ`, is a face).
decls.statement: theorem closedStar_sup_deletion : closedStar K σ ⊔ deletion K σ = K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.link_le_deletion_of_nonempty
decls.doc:
For a nonempty simplex `σ`, the link lies inside the deletion: a face disjoint from a nonempty
`σ` cannot contain it.
decls.statement: theorem link_le_deletion_of_nonempty (hσ : σ.Nonempty) : link K σ ≤ deletion K σ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_link_singleton
decls.doc:
The link of a single vertex `{v}`, written with `insert`: the faces `ρ` not already containing
`v` for which `insert v ρ` is a face. This is the form the combinatorial-manifold link condition
uses.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_link_singleton {v : ι} {ρ : Finset ι} :
    ρ ∈ link K {v} ↔ ρ.Nonempty ∧ v ∉ ρ ∧ insert v ρ ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_closedStar_singleton
decls.doc: The closed star of a single vertex `{v}`, written with `insert`.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_closedStar_singleton {v : ι} {ρ : Finset ι} :
    ρ ∈ closedStar K {v} ↔ ρ ∈ K ∧ insert v ρ ∈ K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.mem_deletion_singleton
decls.doc: The deletion of a single vertex `{v}` consists of the faces not containing `v`.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_deletion_singleton {v : ι} {ρ : Finset ι} :
    ρ ∈ deletion K {v} ↔ ρ ∈ K ∧ v ∉ ρ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.closedStar_empty
decls.doc: The closed star at the empty simplex is the whole complex.
decls.statement: theorem closedStar_empty : closedStar K ∅ = K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.link_empty
decls.doc: The link at the empty simplex is the whole complex.
decls.statement: theorem link_empty : link K ∅ = K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.deletion_empty
decls.doc: The deletion at the empty simplex is empty: every face contains `∅`.
decls.statement: theorem deletion_empty : deletion K ∅ = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.closedStar_mono
decls.doc: The closed star is monotone in the complex.
decls.statement: theorem closedStar_mono (h : K ≤ L) : closedStar K σ ≤ closedStar L σ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.link_mono
decls.doc: The link is monotone in the complex.
decls.statement: theorem link_mono (h : K ≤ L) : link K σ ≤ link L σ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.deletion_mono
decls.doc: The deletion is monotone in the complex.
decls.statement: theorem deletion_mono (h : K ≤ L) : deletion K σ ≤ deletion L σ

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.isCone_closedStar
decls.doc:
The closed star of a face is a cone with apex any vertex of that face: adjoining `v ∈ σ` to
a face `ρ` of the closed star leaves the defining union `ρ ∪ σ` unchanged.
decls.statement: theorem isCone_closedStar (hσ : σ ∈ K) (hv : v ∈ σ) : IsCone (closedStar K σ) v

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.isCone_deletion
decls.doc:
Deleting a nonempty face that misses the apex of a cone leaves a cone with the same apex.
Note that the deletion of a face *containing* the apex need not be a cone: deleting `{v}` itself
destroys the apex.
decls.statement:
theorem isCone_deletion (h : IsCone K v) (hσ : σ.Nonempty) (hv : v ∉ σ) :
    IsCone (deletion K σ) v

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap
decls.doc:
A simplicial map between pre-abstract simplicial complexes is a map of their ambient vertex
types which sends faces to faces.
decls.statement:
structure SimplicialMap (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α)
    (L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex β)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.instFunLike
decls.statement: instance : FunLike (SimplicialMap K L) α β

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.coe_mk
decls.statement: theorem coe_mk (f : α → β) (hf) : ⇑(SimplicialMap.mk f hf : SimplicialMap K L) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.map_face
decls.doc: A simplicial map sends a face to a face.
decls.statement:
theorem map_face (f : SimplicialMap K L) {σ : Finset α} (hσ : σ ∈ K) :
    σ.image f ∈ L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.map_le_iff
decls.doc: A vertex map is simplicial exactly when its image complex is a subcomplex of the codomain.
decls.statement:
theorem map_le_iff (f : α → β) :
    K.map f ≤ L ↔ ∀ ⦃σ : Finset α⦄, σ ∈ K → σ.image f ∈ L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.ofMapLE
decls.doc: Construct a simplicial map from containment of the image complex in the codomain.
decls.statement: def ofMapLE (f : α → β) (h : K.map f ≤ L) : SimplicialMap K L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.coe_ofMapLE
decls.statement: theorem coe_ofMapLE (f : α → β) (h : K.map f ≤ L) : ⇑(ofMapLE f h) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.map_le
decls.doc: The image complex of a simplicial map is contained in its codomain.
decls.statement: theorem map_le (f : SimplicialMap K L) : K.map f ≤ L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.id
decls.doc: The identity simplicial map.
decls.statement: def id [DecidableEq α] (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α) : SimplicialMap K K

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.coe_id
decls.statement: theorem coe_id [DecidableEq α] : ⇑(id K) = _root_.id

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.id_apply
decls.statement: theorem id_apply [DecidableEq α] (x : α) : id K x = x

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.comp
decls.doc: Composition of simplicial maps.
decls.statement: def comp (g : SimplicialMap L P) (f : SimplicialMap K L) : SimplicialMap K P

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.coe_comp
decls.statement:
theorem coe_comp (g : SimplicialMap L P) (f : SimplicialMap K L) :
    ⇑(g.comp f) = g ∘ f

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.comp_apply
decls.statement:
theorem comp_apply (g : SimplicialMap L P) (f : SimplicialMap K L) (x : α) :
    g.comp f x = g (f x)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.comp_id
decls.doc: Composing a simplicial map on the right with the identity leaves it unchanged.
decls.statement: theorem comp_id [DecidableEq α] (f : SimplicialMap K L) : f.comp (id K) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.id_comp
decls.doc: Composing a simplicial map on the left with the identity leaves it unchanged.
decls.statement: theorem id_comp (f : SimplicialMap K L) : (id L).comp f = f

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.comp_assoc
decls.doc: Composition of simplicial maps is associative.
decls.statement:
theorem comp_assoc [DecidableEq δ] (h : SimplicialMap P P') (g : SimplicialMap L P)
    (f : SimplicialMap K L) : (h.comp g).comp f = h.comp (g.comp f)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.domainRestrict
decls.doc: Restrict the domain of a simplicial map to a subcomplex.
decls.statement: def domainRestrict (f : SimplicialMap K L) (h : K' ≤ K) : SimplicialMap K' L

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.coe_domainRestrict
decls.statement:
theorem coe_domainRestrict (f : SimplicialMap K L) (h : K' ≤ K) :
    ⇑(f.domainRestrict h) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.codomainExtend
decls.doc: Regard a simplicial map as landing in a larger complex.
decls.statement: def codomainExtend (f : SimplicialMap K L) (h : L ≤ L') : SimplicialMap K L'

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.coe_codomainExtend
decls.statement:
theorem coe_codomainExtend (f : SimplicialMap K L) (h : L ≤ L') :
    ⇑(f.codomainExtend h) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.toImage
decls.doc: Every vertex map is simplicial into its image complex.
decls.statement: def toImage (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α) (f : α → β) : SimplicialMap K (K.map f)

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.coe_toImage
decls.statement: theorem coe_toImage (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex α) (f : α → β) : ⇑(toImage K f) = f

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.inclusion
decls.doc: The inclusion of a subcomplex, acting as the identity on the ambient vertex type.
decls.statement: def inclusion [DecidableEq α] (h : K ≤ K') : SimplicialMap K K'

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.coe_inclusion
decls.statement: theorem coe_inclusion [DecidableEq α] (h : K ≤ K') : ⇑(inclusion h) = _root_.id

decls.name: TauCeti.PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.SimplicialMap.inclusion_apply
