decls.name: BasedPath.continuous_uncurry_basedPath
decls.doc: The uncurried evaluation of a path of based paths is continuous in both arguments.
decls.statement:
theorem continuous_uncurry_basedPath {α β : BasedPath x₀} (F : Path α β) :
    Continuous fun ts : I × I ↦ (F ts.1).1 ts.2

decls.name: BasedPath.homotopic_of_continuous_square
decls.doc:
**A square with prescribed edges is a path homotopy.** A continuous map on `I × I` that
restricts to `p` at `t = 0` and to `q` at `t = 1`, and is constant along each of the edges `s = 0`
and `s = 1`, exhibits `p` and `q` as homotopic paths.
decls.title: A square with prescribed edges is a path homotopy
decls.statement:
theorem homotopic_of_continuous_square {a b : X} {p q : Path a b} (K : I × I → X)
    (hK_cont : Continuous K) (hK_zero : ∀ s, K (0, s) = p s) (hK_one : ∀ s, K (1, s) = q s)
    (hK_left : ∀ t, K (t, 0) = a) (hK_right : ∀ t, K (t, 1) = b) : p.Homotopic q

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_uFn_zero_left
decls.statement:
theorem joinedInSLSC_uFn_zero_left (s : I) :
    (joinedInSLSC_uFn (0, s) : ℝ) = max 0 (2 * (s : ℝ) - 1)

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_uFn_one_left
decls.statement: theorem joinedInSLSC_uFn_one_left (s : I) : joinedInSLSC_uFn (1, s) = 1

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_uFn_one_right
decls.statement: theorem joinedInSLSC_uFn_one_right (t : I) : joinedInSLSC_uFn (t, 1) = 1

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_vFn_left
decls.statement:
theorem joinedInSLSC_vFn_left (t s : I) :
    (joinedInSLSC_vFn (t, s) : ℝ) = min (2 * (s : ℝ)) 1

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_vFn_zero_right
decls.statement: theorem joinedInSLSC_vFn_zero_right (t : I) : joinedInSLSC_vFn (t, 0) = 0

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_vFn_one_right
decls.statement: theorem joinedInSLSC_vFn_one_right (t : I) : joinedInSLSC_vFn (t, 1) = 1

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_uFn_zero_left_eq_zero_of_le_half
decls.statement:
theorem joinedInSLSC_uFn_zero_left_eq_zero_of_le_half {s : I}
    (hs : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) : joinedInSLSC_uFn (0, s) = 0

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_uFn_zero_left_eq_two_mul_sub_one_of_half_le
decls.statement:
theorem joinedInSLSC_uFn_zero_left_eq_two_mul_sub_one_of_half_le
    {s : I} (hs : 1 / 2 ≤ (s : ℝ)) :
    joinedInSLSC_uFn (0, s) =
      ⟨2 * (s : ℝ) - 1,
        unitInterval.two_mul_sub_one_mem_iff.2 ⟨hs, s.2.2⟩⟩

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_vFn_eq_two_mul_of_le_half
decls.statement:
theorem joinedInSLSC_vFn_eq_two_mul_of_le_half {t s : I}
    (hs : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    joinedInSLSC_vFn (t, s) =
      ⟨2 * (s : ℝ),
        (unitInterval.mul_pos_mem_iff zero_lt_two).2 ⟨s.2.1, hs⟩⟩

decls.name: BasedPath.joinedInSLSC_vFn_eq_one_of_half_le
decls.statement:
theorem joinedInSLSC_vFn_eq_one_of_half_le {t s : I}
    (hs : 1 / 2 ≤ (s : ℝ)) : joinedInSLSC_vFn (t, s) = 1

decls.name: BasedPath.toPath_homotopic_of_joinedIn_pathHomotopyTrivial
decls.doc:
If `α` and `β` are based paths with the same endpoint `v ∈ U`, joined inside
`endpoint ⁻¹' U`, and `U` has the SLSC uniqueness property, then their associated paths
`α.toPath` and `β.toPath` are homotopic (after casting to a common endpoint).

This is the heart of the sheet-injectivity argument: a path in the based-path space descends
to a free homotopy of paths in `X` whose endpoint trace is a loop in `U`, which is killed by
the SLSC hypothesis.
decls.statement:
theorem toPath_homotopic_of_joinedIn_pathHomotopyTrivial
    {U : Set X} (hU_slsc : IsPathHomotopyTrivial U)
    {α β : BasedPath x₀}
    (heq : endpoint α = endpoint β)
    (hAB : JoinedIn (endpoint (x₀ := x₀) ⁻¹' U) α β) :
    Path.Homotopic (α.toPath.cast rfl heq.symm) β.toPath

decls.name: BasedPath.pathComponentIn_ofPath_eq_of_homotopic
decls.doc:
Path components of `endpoint ⁻¹' U` are invariant under endpoint-preserving homotopy:
if `p ≃ q` are homotopic paths from `x₀` to `y ∈ U`, then the based paths `ofPath p` and
`ofPath q` lie in the same path component of `endpoint ⁻¹' U`.
decls.statement:
theorem pathComponentIn_ofPath_eq_of_homotopic
    {U : Set X} {y : X} (hy : y ∈ U)
    {p q : Path x₀ y} (h : Path.Homotopic p q) :
    pathComponentIn (endpoint (x₀ := x₀) ⁻¹' U) (ofPath p) =
      pathComponentIn (endpoint (x₀ := x₀) ⁻¹' U) (ofPath q)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover
decls.doc:
The endpoint-plus-homotopy-class model for the universal cover. The topology is supplied below
as the quotient topology from `BasedPath x₀`.
decls.statement: structure UniversalCover (x₀ : X)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath
decls.doc: The quotient map from based paths to endpoint/path-homotopy classes.
decls.statement: def ofBasedPath (x₀ : X) (α : BasedPath x₀) : UniversalCover x₀

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath_def
decls.doc: `ofBasedPath` records the endpoint and homotopy class of its based path.
decls.statement:
theorem ofBasedPath_def (α : BasedPath x₀) :
    ofBasedPath x₀ α =
      mk (BasedPath.endpoint α) (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk α.toPath)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.instTopologicalSpaceUniversalCover
decls.doc:
The topology on `UniversalCover x₀` as the quotient topology coinduced from the compact-open
topology on `BasedPath x₀` via `ofBasedPath`. See the module-level `## Implementation note` for
why we do not use the Hatcher-style bespoke basis.
decls.statement: instance instTopologicalSpaceUniversalCover (x₀ : X) : TopologicalSpace (UniversalCover x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.continuous_ofBasedPath
decls.doc: The canonical map from based paths to the universal cover is continuous.
decls.statement: theorem continuous_ofBasedPath (x₀ : X) : Continuous (ofBasedPath x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath_ofPath
decls.doc:
`ofBasedPath` applied to the canonical based path from `p : Path x₀ y` gives the
endpoint-and-homotopy-class pair.
decls.statement:
theorem ofBasedPath_ofPath {y : X} (p : Path x₀ y) :
    ofBasedPath x₀ (BasedPath.ofPath p) = mk y (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.surjective_ofBasedPath
decls.doc: Every point of `UniversalCover x₀` is represented by some based path.
decls.statement: theorem surjective_ofBasedPath (x₀ : X) : Function.Surjective (ofBasedPath x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.isQuotientMap_ofBasedPath
decls.doc:
`ofBasedPath` is a quotient map: `UniversalCover x₀` carries the quotient topology from
`BasedPath x₀` under endpoint-preserving path homotopy.
decls.statement: theorem isQuotientMap_ofBasedPath (x₀ : X) : IsQuotientMap (ofBasedPath x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.proj_ofBasedPath
decls.doc: `proj` composed with `ofBasedPath` reads off the endpoint of the representative.
decls.statement:
theorem proj_ofBasedPath (x₀ : X) (γ : BasedPath x₀) :
    proj (ofBasedPath x₀ γ) = BasedPath.endpoint γ

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.endpoint_eq_of_ofBasedPath_eq
decls.doc: Equal images under `ofBasedPath` have equal endpoints.

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.toPath_homotopic_of_ofBasedPath_eq
decls.doc:
Equality in the universal cover induces an endpoint-preserving homotopy of representative
based paths.
decls.statement:
theorem toPath_homotopic_of_ofBasedPath_eq {α β : BasedPath x₀}
    (h : ofBasedPath x₀ α = ofBasedPath x₀ β) :
    Path.Homotopic
      (α.toPath.cast rfl (endpoint_eq_of_ofBasedPath_eq h).symm)
      β.toPath

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath_eq_of_homotopic_toPath
decls.doc:
If two based paths have the same endpoint and homotopic `toPath`s (after casting to a
common target), then they represent the same element of the `UniversalCover`.
decls.statement:
theorem ofBasedPath_eq_of_homotopic_toPath {α β : BasedPath x₀}
    (heq : BasedPath.endpoint α = BasedPath.endpoint β)
    (h : Path.Homotopic (α.toPath.cast rfl heq.symm) β.toPath) :
    ofBasedPath x₀ α = ofBasedPath x₀ β

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.continuous_proj
decls.doc: The endpoint projection from the universal cover is continuous.
decls.statement: theorem continuous_proj (x₀ : X) : Continuous (proj (x₀ := x₀))

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.isOpenMap_proj
decls.doc:
The endpoint projection `UniversalCover x₀ → X` is an open map when `X` is locally
path-connected.
decls.statement:
theorem isOpenMap_proj [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] (x₀ : X) :
    IsOpenMap (proj (x₀ := x₀))

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.basedPathComponent
decls.doc: The path component (in `endpoint ⁻¹' U`) of the based path `ofPath p`.
decls.statement: def basedPathComponent (U : Set X) {y : X} (p : Path x₀ y) : Set (BasedPath x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.basedPathSheet
decls.doc:
The sheet over `U` (with `x ∈ U`) corresponding to a homotopy class
`q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x`, expressed as a set of based paths.
decls.statement:
def basedPathSheet (U : Set X) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) : Set (BasedPath x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.basedPathSheet_mk
decls.doc: `basedPathSheet` of a quotient class unfolds to the path component of any representative.
decls.statement:
theorem basedPathSheet_mk (U : Set X) (hxU : x ∈ U) (p : Path x₀ x) :
    basedPathSheet U hxU (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p) = basedPathComponent U p

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.basedPathSheet_subset_endpoint_preimage
decls.doc: Every based path in a `basedPathSheet` over `U` has its endpoint in `U`.
decls.statement:
theorem basedPathSheet_subset_endpoint_preimage (U : Set X) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
    basedPathSheet U hxU q ⊆ BasedPath.endpoint (x₀ := x₀) ⁻¹' U

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet
decls.doc: The sheet over `U` corresponding to `q`, viewed as a subset of `UniversalCover x₀`.
decls.statement:
def sheet (U : Set X) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) : Set (UniversalCover x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet_subset_proj_preimage
decls.doc: Points of the sheet over `U` project into `U`.
decls.statement:
theorem sheet_subset_proj_preimage (U : Set X) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
    sheet U hxU q ⊆ proj (x₀ := x₀) ⁻¹' U

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.pathComponent_preimage_eq_of_ofBasedPath_eq
decls.doc:
Two based paths with equal `ofBasedPath` images lie in the same path component of any
endpoint preimage of a set containing their common endpoint. This expresses saturation under
the quotient map `ofBasedPath`.
decls.statement:
theorem pathComponent_preimage_eq_of_ofBasedPath_eq
    {U : Set X} {α β : BasedPath x₀}
    (hα_end : BasedPath.endpoint α ∈ U)
    (hαβ : ofBasedPath x₀ α = ofBasedPath x₀ β) :
    pathComponentIn (BasedPath.endpoint (x₀ := x₀) ⁻¹' U) α =
      pathComponentIn (BasedPath.endpoint (x₀ := x₀) ⁻¹' U) β

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.mem_basedPathComponent_of_ofBasedPath_eq
decls.doc: Membership in a based-path component is preserved under equality in the universal cover.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_basedPathComponent_of_ofBasedPath_eq {U : Set X} {y : X} {p : Path x₀ y}
    {α β : BasedPath x₀} (hβ : β ∈ basedPathComponent U p)
    (hαβ : ofBasedPath x₀ α = ofBasedPath x₀ β) :
    α ∈ basedPathComponent U p

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath_preimage_sheet
decls.doc:
The preimage of a sheet under `ofBasedPath` is the corresponding `basedPathSheet`.
This expresses that the sheet is saturated under the `ofBasedPath` quotient.
decls.statement:
theorem ofBasedPath_preimage_sheet (U : Set X) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
    ofBasedPath x₀ ⁻¹' sheet U hxU q = basedPathSheet U hxU q

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.ofBasedPath_mem_sheet_iff
decls.doc:
Saturated membership criterion: a based path's image lies in a sheet iff the based path
itself lies in the corresponding `basedPathSheet`.

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.isOpen_sheet
decls.doc: A sheet over an open set is open under the local hypotheses for universal covers.
decls.statement:
theorem isOpen_sheet [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X]
    (U : Set X) (hU_open : IsOpen U) (hxU : x ∈ U)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
    IsOpen (sheet U hxU q)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.mem_sheet_self
decls.doc: A path representative belongs to the sheet indexed by its own homotopy class.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_sheet_self {U : Set X} (hxU : x ∈ U) (p : Path x₀ x) :
    ofBasedPath x₀ (BasedPath.ofPath p) ∈ sheet U hxU (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk p)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.proj_surjOn_sheet
decls.doc: Sheet surjection onto `U`: every point of `U` is the projection of a point of the sheet.
decls.statement:
theorem proj_surjOn_sheet
    {U : Set X} (hU_pathConn : IsPathConnected U)
    (hxU : x ∈ U) (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
    (sheet U hxU q).SurjOn (proj (x₀ := x₀)) U

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.pairwise_disjoint_sheet
decls.doc:
Sheets over the same good neighborhood, indexed by `Path.Homotopic.Quotient`, are pairwise
disjoint.
decls.statement:
theorem pairwise_disjoint_sheet
    {U : Set X} (hU_slsc : IsPathHomotopyTrivial U) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    Pairwise fun (q₁ q₂ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) ↦
      Disjoint (sheet U hxU q₁) (sheet U hxU q₂)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.sheet_exhaustive
decls.doc: Sheets exhaust `proj ⁻¹' U`: every element of the preimage lies in some sheet.
decls.statement:
theorem sheet_exhaustive
    {U : Set X} (hU_pathConn : IsPathConnected U)
    (hxU : x ∈ U) :
    (proj (x₀ := x₀) ⁻¹' U) ⊆ ⋃ q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x, sheet U hxU q

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.proj_injOn_sheet
decls.doc: In a good neighborhood `U`, the projection `proj` is injective on each sheet.
decls.statement:
theorem proj_injOn_sheet
    {U : Set X} (hU_slsc : IsPathHomotopyTrivial U)
    (hxU : x ∈ U) (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x₀ x) :
    (sheet U hxU q).InjOn (proj (x₀ := x₀))

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.isAspherical
decls.doc:
Every real additive circle is aspherical. The nonzero-period hypothesis is needed only
for the later identification of its fundamental group with `ℤ`.
decls.statement:
theorem isAspherical (p : ℝ) (x : AddCircle p) :
    TauCeti.IsAspherical (AddCircle p) x

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.isEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne
decls.doc:
A real additive circle with nonzero period is an Eilenberg--Mac Lane space of type
`K(ℤ, 1)`, with `ℤ` written multiplicatively to match the fundamental group.
decls.statement:
theorem isEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne (p : ℝ) (hp : p ≠ 0) (x : AddCircle p) :
    TauCeti.IsEilenbergMacLaneSpaceOne (Multiplicative ℤ) (AddCircle p) x

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples
decls.doc:
For a covering projection `(↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p` from a simply connected preconnected
topological additive commutative group with totally disconnected period subgroup, the
fundamental group of `AddCircle p` is the multiplicative period subgroup.
decls.statement:
def fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples
    (hcov : IsCoveringMap ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p))
    {x : AddCircle p} (e : ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x}) :
    FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x ≃* Multiplicative (zmultiples p)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.addCircleMulEquiv_symm_addRightZMultiples
decls.statement:
lemma addCircleMulEquiv_symm_addRightZMultiples (n : Multiplicative (zmultiples p)) :
    Deck.addCircleMulEquiv.symm (Deck.addRightZMultiples n.toAdd) = n

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples_toPeriod_symm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples_toPeriod_symm_apply
    (n : Multiplicative (zmultiples p)) :
    (((MulEquiv.op Deck.addCircleMulEquiv.symm).trans
      (MulOpposite.opMulEquiv (M := Multiplicative (zmultiples p))).symm).symm n) =
        MulOpposite.op (Deck.addCircleMulEquiv n)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples_apply_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Characterization of the period-subgroup element assigned by
`fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples`: a loop class maps to `n` exactly when its monodromy
translate of the chosen lift differs by the element `n`.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples_apply_eq_iff
    (hcov : IsCoveringMap ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p))
    {x : AddCircle p} (e : ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x})
    (γ : FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x) (n : Multiplicative (zmultiples p)) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples hcov e γ = n ↔
      (hcov.monodromy γ e : 𝕜) = (e : 𝕜) + (n.toAdd : 𝕜)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples_symm_monodromy
decls.doc:
The inverse of the period-subgroup equivalence sends `n` to the loop class whose monodromy
translates the chosen lift by `n`.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples_symm_monodromy
    (hcov : IsCoveringMap ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p))
    {x : AddCircle p} (e : ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x})
    (n : Multiplicative (zmultiples p)) :
    (hcov.monodromy ((fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples hcov e).symm n) e : 𝕜) =
      (e : 𝕜) + (n.toAdd : 𝕜)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
A loop class maps to `1` under the period-subgroup equivalence exactly when its monodromy
fixes the chosen lift.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples_eq_one_iff
    (hcov : IsCoveringMap ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p))
    {x : AddCircle p} (e : ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x})
    (γ : FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquivZMultiples hcov e γ = 1 ↔ hcov.monodromy γ e = e

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt
decls.doc:
For a covering projection `(↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p` from a simply connected preconnected
topological additive commutative group with totally disconnected non-torsion period subgroup,
the fundamental group of `AddCircle p` is infinite cyclic:
`FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x ≃* Multiplicative ℤ`.
decls.statement:
def fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt
    (hcov : IsCoveringMap ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p)) (hp : ¬ IsOfFinAddOrder p)
    {x : AddCircle p} (e : ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x}) :
    FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x ≃* Multiplicative ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt_apply_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Characterization of the integer assigned by `fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt`: a loop
class maps to `n` exactly when its monodromy translate of the chosen lift differs by `n • p`.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt_apply_eq_iff
    (hcov : IsCoveringMap ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p)) (hp : ¬ IsOfFinAddOrder p)
    {x : AddCircle p} (e : ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x})
    (γ : FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x) (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt hcov hp e γ = n ↔
      (hcov.monodromy γ e : 𝕜) = (e : 𝕜) + n.toAdd • p

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt_symm_monodromy
decls.doc:
The inverse generic integer equivalence sends `n` to the loop class whose monodromy
translates the chosen lift by `n • p`.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt_symm_monodromy
    (hcov : IsCoveringMap ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p)) (hp : ¬ IsOfFinAddOrder p)
    {x : AddCircle p} (e : ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x}) (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    (hcov.monodromy ((fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt hcov hp e).symm n) e : 𝕜) =
      (e : 𝕜) + n.toAdd • p

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
A loop class maps to `1` under the generic integer equivalence exactly when its monodromy
fixes the chosen lift.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt_eq_one_iff
    (hcov : IsCoveringMap ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p)) (hp : ¬ IsOfFinAddOrder p)
    {x : AddCircle p} (e : ((↑) : 𝕜 → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x})
    (γ : FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquivInt hcov hp e γ = 1 ↔ hcov.monodromy γ e = e

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv
decls.doc:
For a nonzero real period `p`, the fundamental group of the circle `AddCircle p`, based at
any point `x` with a chosen lift `e : (↑) ⁻¹' {x}`, is infinite cyclic:
`FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x ≃* Multiplicative ℤ`.

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_apply_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Characterization of the integer assigned by `fundamentalGroupMulEquiv`: a loop class maps
to `n` exactly when its monodromy translate of the chosen lift differs by `n • p`.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_apply_eq_iff (hp : p ≠ 0) {x : AddCircle p}
    (e : ((↑) : ℝ → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x}) (γ : FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x)
    (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquiv p hp e γ = n ↔
      ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe p).monodromy γ e : ℝ) = (e : ℝ) + n.toAdd • p

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_symm_monodromy
decls.doc:
The inverse equivalence sends `n` to the loop class whose monodromy translates the chosen
lift by `n • p`.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_symm_monodromy (hp : p ≠ 0) {x : AddCircle p}
    (e : ((↑) : ℝ → AddCircle p) ⁻¹' {x}) (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe p).monodromy ((fundamentalGroupMulEquiv p hp e).symm n) e :
      ℝ) = (e : ℝ) + n.toAdd • p

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
A loop class maps to `1` under `fundamentalGroupMulEquiv` exactly when its monodromy fixes
the chosen lift.

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero
decls.doc:
The fundamental group of the circle `AddCircle p` based at `0`, with the lift `0 : ℝ`, is
`Multiplicative ℤ`.
decls.statement:
def fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) 0 ≃* Multiplicative ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_apply_eq_iff
decls.doc: Characterization of the integer assigned by the basepoint-`0` specialization.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_apply_eq_iff (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (γ : FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) 0) (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero p hp γ = n ↔
      ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe p).monodromy γ ⟨0, by simp⟩ : ℝ) = n.toAdd • p

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_apply
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_apply (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (γ : FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) 0) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero p hp γ = fundamentalGroupMulEquiv p hp ⟨0, by simp⟩ γ

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_symm_apply
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_symm_apply (hp : p ≠ 0) (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    (fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero p hp).symm n =
      (fundamentalGroupMulEquiv p hp ⟨0, by simp⟩).symm n

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_symm_monodromy
decls.doc: The inverse of the basepoint-`0` specialization has monodromy translation `n • p`.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_symm_monodromy (hp : p ≠ 0) (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe p).monodromy ((fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero p hp).symm n)
      ⟨0, by simp⟩ : ℝ) = n.toAdd • p

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
A loop class maps to `1` under the basepoint-`0` specialization exactly when its monodromy
fixes the zero lift.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero_eq_one_iff (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (γ : FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) 0) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero p hp γ = 1 ↔
      (AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe p).monodromy γ ⟨0, by simp⟩ = ⟨0, by simp⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.UnitAddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The fundamental group of the unit circle `S¹ = ℝ ⧸ ℤ` is `ℤ`:
`FundamentalGroup UnitAddCircle 0 ≃* Multiplicative ℤ`. This is the classical `π₁(S¹) ≅ ℤ`.
decls.statement:
def fundamentalGroupMulEquiv :
    FundamentalGroup UnitAddCircle 0 ≃* Multiplicative ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.UnitAddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_apply_eq_iff
decls.doc: Characterization of the integer assigned by the unit-circle equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_apply_eq_iff (γ : FundamentalGroup UnitAddCircle 0)
    (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquiv γ = n ↔
      ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe 1).monodromy γ ⟨0, by simp⟩ : ℝ) = n.toAdd

decls.name: TauCeti.UnitAddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_symm_monodromy
decls.doc: The inverse of the unit-circle equivalence has monodromy translation by `n`.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_symm_monodromy (n : Multiplicative ℤ) :
    ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe 1).monodromy (fundamentalGroupMulEquiv.symm n)
      ⟨0, by simp⟩ : ℝ) = n.toAdd

decls.name: TauCeti.UnitAddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_eq_one_iff
decls.doc: A unit-circle loop class maps to `1` exactly when its monodromy fixes the zero lift.
decls.statement:
lemma fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_eq_one_iff (γ : FundamentalGroup UnitAddCircle 0) :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquiv γ = 1 ↔
      (AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe 1).monodromy γ ⟨0, by simp⟩ = ⟨0, by simp⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.subsingleton_homotopyGroup
decls.doc:
Every higher homotopy group of a real circle is trivial. The index type `N` being
nontrivial expresses that the dimension is at least two.
decls.statement: instance subsingleton_homotopyGroup : Subsingleton (HomotopyGroup N (AddCircle p) x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.homotopyGroup_eq_one
decls.doc: Every higher homotopy class of a real circle is the identity.
decls.statement: theorem homotopyGroup_eq_one [DecidableEq N] (a : HomotopyGroup N (AddCircle p) x) : a = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.homotopyGroupPi_eq_one
decls.doc: Every element of `π_(n + 2)` of a real circle is the identity.
decls.statement: theorem homotopyGroupPi_eq_one (n : ℕ) (a : π_ (n + 2) (AddCircle p) x) : a = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.nontrivial_fundamentalGroup
decls.doc:
The fundamental group of the circle `AddCircle p` (`p ≠ 0`), based at any point `x`, is
nontrivial. See `fundamentalGroupMulEquiv` for the full winding-number classification.
decls.statement:
theorem nontrivial_fundamentalGroup (hp : p ≠ 0) (x : AddCircle p) :
    Nontrivial (FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.infinite_fundamentalGroup
decls.doc:
The fundamental group of the circle `AddCircle p` (`p ≠ 0`), based at any point `x`, is
infinite. See `fundamentalGroupMulEquiv` for the full winding-number classification.
decls.statement:
theorem infinite_fundamentalGroup (hp : p ≠ 0) (x : AddCircle p) :
    Infinite (FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) x)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.nontrivial_fundamentalGroup_zero
decls.doc: The fundamental group of the circle `AddCircle p` (`p ≠ 0`), based at `0`, is nontrivial.
decls.statement:
theorem nontrivial_fundamentalGroup_zero (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Nontrivial (FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.infinite_fundamentalGroup_zero
decls.doc: The fundamental group of the circle `AddCircle p` (`p ≠ 0`), based at `0`, is infinite.
decls.statement:
theorem infinite_fundamentalGroup_zero (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    Infinite (FundamentalGroup (AddCircle p) 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.not_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
The circle `AddCircle p` (`p ≠ 0`) is **not simply connected**: its fundamental group is
nontrivial, whereas a simply connected space has a subsingleton fundamental group.
decls.statement: theorem not_simplyConnectedSpace (hp : p ≠ 0) : ¬ SimplyConnectedSpace (AddCircle p)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.not_contractibleSpace
decls.doc:
The circle `AddCircle p` (`p ≠ 0`) is **not contractible**: a contractible space is simply
connected, and the circle is not.
decls.statement: theorem not_contractibleSpace (hp : p ≠ 0) : ¬ ContractibleSpace (AddCircle p)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.isEmpty_homeomorph_of_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
The circle `AddCircle p` (`p ≠ 0`) is not homeomorphic to any simply connected space: a
homeomorphism is in particular a homotopy equivalence, and simple connectivity transfers along
homotopy equivalences, which the circle does not enjoy.
decls.statement:
theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_of_simplyConnectedSpace (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace Y] [SimplyConnectedSpace Y] :
    IsEmpty (AddCircle p ≃ₜ Y)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.isEmpty_homeomorph_realTopologicalVectorSpace
decls.doc:
The circle `AddCircle p` (`p ≠ 0`) is not homeomorphic to any real topological vector space
(in particular, to any real normed space), since such a space is contractible, hence simply
connected.
decls.statement:
theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_realTopologicalVectorSpace (hp : p ≠ 0) (E : Type*)
    [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace E] [ContinuousAdd E] [ContinuousSMul ℝ E] :
    IsEmpty (AddCircle p ≃ₜ E)

decls.name: TauCeti.AddCircle.isEmpty_homeomorph_real
decls.doc:
The circle `AddCircle p` (`p ≠ 0`) is not homeomorphic to the real line: the circle is not
simply connected but `ℝ` is contractible.
decls.statement: theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_real (hp : p ≠ 0) : IsEmpty (AddCircle p ≃ₜ ℝ)

decls.name: TauCeti.UnitAddCircle.nontrivial_fundamentalGroup_zero
decls.doc: The fundamental group of the unit circle `S¹ = ℝ ⧸ ℤ`, based at `0`, is nontrivial.
decls.statement: theorem nontrivial_fundamentalGroup_zero : Nontrivial (FundamentalGroup UnitAddCircle 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.UnitAddCircle.infinite_fundamentalGroup_zero
decls.doc: The fundamental group of the unit circle `S¹ = ℝ ⧸ ℤ`, based at `0`, is infinite.
decls.statement: theorem infinite_fundamentalGroup_zero : Infinite (FundamentalGroup UnitAddCircle 0)

decls.name: TauCeti.UnitAddCircle.not_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc: The unit circle `S¹ = ℝ ⧸ ℤ` is not simply connected.
decls.statement: theorem not_simplyConnectedSpace : ¬ SimplyConnectedSpace UnitAddCircle

decls.name: TauCeti.UnitAddCircle.not_contractibleSpace
decls.doc: The unit circle `S¹ = ℝ ⧸ ℤ` is not contractible.
decls.statement: theorem not_contractibleSpace : ¬ ContractibleSpace UnitAddCircle

decls.name: TauCeti.UnitAddCircle.isEmpty_homeomorph_real
decls.doc: The unit circle `S¹ = ℝ ⧸ ℤ` is not homeomorphic to the real line.
decls.statement: theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_real : IsEmpty (UnitAddCircle ≃ₜ ℝ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.homeomorphCircle_symm_one
decls.doc:
The homeomorphism `AddCircle.homeomorphCircle : AddCircle (2 * π) ≃ₜ Circle` carries the
basepoint `0` to `1`, so its inverse carries `1` back to `0`. This is the basepoint hypothesis
that transports the additive-circle computation to `Circle`.
decls.statement:
theorem homeomorphCircle_symm_one :
    (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle (T := 2 * Real.pi) Real.two_pi_pos.ne').symm 1 = 0

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv
decls.doc:
The fundamental group of the complex unit circle `Circle = {z : ℂ | ‖z‖ = 1}`, based at
`1`, is `Multiplicative ℤ`: `π₁(S¹) ≅ ℤ`. It is obtained by transporting the additive-circle
computation `TauCeti.AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero` across the homeomorphism
`AddCircle.homeomorphCircle : AddCircle (2 * π) ≃ₜ Circle`, which carries the basepoint `0` to
`1`.
decls.statement: def fundamentalGroupMulEquiv : FundamentalGroup Circle 1 ≃* Multiplicative ℤ

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_def
decls.doc:
`fundamentalGroupMulEquiv` factors as the homeomorphism-invariance isomorphism of
`AddCircle.homeomorphCircle.symm` (based at `1 ↦ 0`) composed with the additive-circle
computation `AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero`. This exposes the otherwise-opaque
definition, so a downstream consumer can rewrite a loop's image in `Multiplicative ℤ` through the
component `@[simp]` lemmas `FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquivOfEq_apply` and the
`AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero` characterization.
decls.statement:
theorem fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_def :
    fundamentalGroupMulEquiv =
      (FundamentalGroup.homeomorphMulEquivOfEq
          (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle (T := 2 * Real.pi) Real.two_pi_pos.ne').symm
          homeomorphCircle_symm_one).trans
        (AddCircle.fundamentalGroupMulEquiv_zero (2 * Real.pi) Real.two_pi_pos.ne')

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.nontrivial_fundamentalGroup
decls.doc:
The fundamental group of the complex unit circle `Circle`, based at `1`, is nontrivial. See
`fundamentalGroupMulEquiv` for the full identification with `Multiplicative ℤ`.
decls.statement: theorem nontrivial_fundamentalGroup : Nontrivial (FundamentalGroup Circle 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.infinite_fundamentalGroup
decls.doc:
The fundamental group of the complex unit circle `Circle`, based at `1`, is infinite. See
`fundamentalGroupMulEquiv` for the full identification with `Multiplicative ℤ`.
decls.statement: theorem infinite_fundamentalGroup : Infinite (FundamentalGroup Circle 1)

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.not_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
The complex unit circle `Circle` is **not simply connected**: its fundamental group is
nontrivial, whereas a simply connected space has a subsingleton fundamental group.
decls.statement: theorem not_simplyConnectedSpace : ¬ SimplyConnectedSpace Circle

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.not_contractibleSpace
decls.doc:
The complex unit circle `Circle` is **not contractible**: a contractible space is simply
connected, and the circle is not.
decls.statement: theorem not_contractibleSpace : ¬ ContractibleSpace Circle

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.isEmpty_homeomorph_of_simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc:
The complex unit circle `Circle` is not homeomorphic to any simply connected space: a
homeomorphism is a homotopy equivalence, and simple connectivity transfers along homotopy
equivalences, which the circle does not enjoy.
decls.statement:
theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_of_simplyConnectedSpace (Y : Type*) [TopologicalSpace Y]
    [SimplyConnectedSpace Y] : IsEmpty (Circle ≃ₜ Y)

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.isEmpty_homeomorph_realTopologicalVectorSpace
decls.doc:
The complex unit circle `Circle` is not homeomorphic to any real topological vector space
(in particular, to any real normed space), since such a space is contractible, hence simply
connected.
decls.statement:
theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_realTopologicalVectorSpace (E : Type*) [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E]
    [TopologicalSpace E] [ContinuousAdd E] [ContinuousSMul ℝ E] : IsEmpty (Circle ≃ₜ E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Circle.isEmpty_homeomorph_real
decls.doc:
The complex unit circle `Circle` is not homeomorphic to the real line: the circle is not
simply connected but `ℝ` is contractible.
decls.statement: theorem isEmpty_homeomorph_real : IsEmpty (Circle ≃ₜ ℝ)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.isCoveringMap
decls.doc:
The endpoint projection `proj` is a covering map, assuming `X` is semilocally simply
connected, locally path-connected, and path-connected.
decls.statement:
theorem isCoveringMap [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [PathConnectedSpace X]
    [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (x₀ : X) :
    IsCoveringMap (proj (x₀ := x₀))

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.discreteTopology_fiber
decls.doc: Fibers of the universal cover are discrete.
decls.statement:
instance discreteTopology_fiber [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [PathConnectedSpace X]
    [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (x₀ x : X) :
    DiscreteTopology (proj (x₀ := x₀) ⁻¹' {x})

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.joined_basepoint_ofBasedPath
decls.doc:
Every point of `UniversalCover x₀` is joined to the point represented by the constant
path. The connecting path is the family of initial segments `t ↦ α |_[0, t]`.
decls.statement:
theorem joined_basepoint_ofBasedPath (α : BasedPath x₀) :
    Joined (ofBasedPath x₀ (BasedPath.ofPath (Path.refl x₀))) (ofBasedPath x₀ α)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.pathConnectedSpace
decls.doc: The universal cover is path-connected.
decls.statement:
instance pathConnectedSpace (x₀ : X) :
    PathConnectedSpace (TauCeti.UniversalCover x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.liftPath_apply_one_eq_ofBasedPath_append
decls.doc:
The lift through `proj` of a path `γ` starting at the class of `α` ends at the class of
the concatenated based path `α.append γ`.
decls.statement:
theorem liftPath_apply_one_eq_ofBasedPath_append
    [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [PathConnectedSpace X]
    [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] {α : BasedPath x₀} {y : X}
    (γ : Path (BasedPath.endpoint α) y) :
    (isCoveringMap x₀).liftPath γ (ofBasedPath x₀ α)
      (by simp) 1 =
      ofBasedPath x₀ (BasedPath.append α γ)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.simplyConnectedSpace
decls.doc: The universal cover is simply connected.
decls.statement:
instance simplyConnectedSpace [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [PathConnectedSpace X]
    [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (x₀ : X) :
    SimplyConnectedSpace (TauCeti.UniversalCover x₀)

decls.name: TauCeti.UniversalCover.existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts
decls.doc:
Universal property of the universal cover: a continuous map from a simply connected,
locally path-connected space lifts uniquely after specifying the image of one point.
decls.statement:
theorem existsUnique_continuousMap_lifts {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    [SimplyConnectedSpace A] [LocallyPathConnectedSpace A]
    [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] [PathConnectedSpace X]
    [SemilocallySimplyConnectedSpace X] (x₀ : X)
    (f : C(A, X)) (a₀ : A) (e₀ : TauCeti.UniversalCover x₀) (he : proj e₀ = f a₀) :
    ∃! F : C(A, TauCeti.UniversalCover x₀), F a₀ = e₀ ∧ proj ∘ F = f

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck
decls.doc:
The deck transformations of a map `p : E → B`, as the subgroup of homeomorphisms of `E`
which commute with `p`. For a covering projection, this is the usual deck transformation
group.
decls.statement: def Deck : Subgroup (E ≃ₜ E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.mem_iff
decls.doc: A homeomorphism lies in `Deck p` exactly when it preserves `p` pointwise.
decls.statement: lemma mem_iff (φ : E ≃ₜ E) : φ ∈ Deck p ↔ ∀ e, p (φ e) = p e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.map_proj
decls.doc: A deck transformation preserves the projection map pointwise.
decls.statement: lemma map_proj (φ : Deck p) (e : E) : p (φ.1 e) = p e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.mapsTo_fiber
decls.doc: A deck transformation preserves each fibre of the projection.
decls.statement: lemma mapsTo_fiber (φ : Deck p) (b : B) : Set.MapsTo φ.1 (p ⁻¹' {b}) (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.mapsTo_fiber_symm
decls.doc: The inverse of a deck transformation also preserves each fibre of the projection.
decls.statement:
lemma mapsTo_fiber_symm (φ : Deck p) (b : B) :
    Set.MapsTo φ.1.symm (p ⁻¹' {b}) (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorph
decls.doc:
A deck transformation restricts to a homeomorphism of every fibre of the projection,
the restriction of its underlying homeomorphism along `Homeomorph.subtype`.
decls.statement: def fiberHomeomorph (φ : Deck p) (b : B) : p ⁻¹' {b} ≃ₜ p ⁻¹' {b}

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorph_apply
decls.doc:
On points, the fibre homeomorphism induced by a deck transformation is just evaluation
of that transformation.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorph_apply (φ : Deck p) (b : B) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (fiberHomeomorph φ b e : E) = φ.1 e.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorph_symm_apply
decls.doc:
On points, the inverse fibre homeomorphism induced by a deck transformation is
evaluation of the inverse homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorph_symm_apply (φ : Deck p) (b : B) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    ((fiberHomeomorph φ b).symm e : E) = φ.1.symm e.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.smul_eq_apply
decls.doc:
On points, the action of a deck transformation is evaluation of its underlying
homeomorphism. The action itself is inherited, by subgroup transfer, from the tautological
action of `E ≃ₜ E` on `E`.
decls.statement: lemma smul_eq_apply (φ : Deck p) (e : E) : φ • e = φ.1 e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.inv_smul_eq_symm_apply
decls.doc: Applying the inverse deck transformation is evaluation of the inverse homeomorphism.
decls.statement: lemma inv_smul_eq_symm_apply (φ : Deck p) (e : E) : (φ⁻¹ : Deck p) • e = φ.1.symm e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.map_symm_eq_of_map_eq
decls.doc:
If `h : E ≃ₜ F` lies over the base, then its inverse also lies over the base in the
opposite direction.
decls.statement:
lemma map_symm_eq_of_map_eq (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (f : F) :
    p (h.symm f) = q f

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjHomeomorph
decls.doc: The homeomorphism obtained by conjugating an end-homeomorphism by `h`.
decls.statement: def conjHomeomorph (h : E ≃ₜ F) (φ : E ≃ₜ E) : F ≃ₜ F

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjHomeomorph_refl
decls.doc: Conjugating by the identity homeomorphism leaves an end-homeomorphism unchanged.
decls.statement:
lemma conjHomeomorph_refl (φ : E ≃ₜ E) :
    conjHomeomorph (Homeomorph.refl E) φ = φ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjHomeomorph_apply
decls.doc: Conjugation by a homeomorphism evaluates by `h.symm`, then `φ`, then `h`.
decls.statement:
lemma conjHomeomorph_apply (h : E ≃ₜ F) (φ : E ≃ₜ E) (f : F) :
    conjHomeomorph h φ f = h (φ (h.symm f))

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjHomeomorph_symm
decls.doc: The inverse of a conjugated homeomorphism is the conjugate of the inverse.
decls.statement:
lemma conjHomeomorph_symm (h : E ≃ₜ F) (φ : E ≃ₜ E) :
    (conjHomeomorph h φ).symm = conjHomeomorph h φ.symm

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjHomeomorph_one
decls.doc: Conjugation sends the identity homeomorphism to the identity homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma conjHomeomorph_one (h : E ≃ₜ F) :
    conjHomeomorph h 1 = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjHomeomorph_mul
decls.doc: Conjugation sends composition of homeomorphisms to composition of the conjugates.
decls.statement:
lemma conjHomeomorph_mul (h : E ≃ₜ F) (φ ψ : E ≃ₜ E) :
    conjHomeomorph h (φ * ψ) = conjHomeomorph h φ * conjHomeomorph h ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjHomeomorph_trans
decls.doc: Conjugating twice is the same as conjugating by the composite homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma conjHomeomorph_trans (h : E ≃ₜ F) (k : F ≃ₜ G) (φ : E ≃ₜ E) :
    conjHomeomorph k (conjHomeomorph h φ) = conjHomeomorph (h.trans k) φ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjHomeomorphMulEquiv
decls.doc: Conjugation by a homeomorphism as a multiplicative equivalence of homeomorphism groups.
decls.statement: def conjHomeomorphMulEquiv (h : E ≃ₜ F) : (E ≃ₜ E) ≃* (F ≃ₜ F)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjHomeomorph_mem_deck
decls.doc:
Conjugation by an over-base homeomorphism sends deck transformations to deck
transformations.
decls.statement:
lemma conjHomeomorph_mem_deck (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (φ : Deck p) :
    conjHomeomorph h φ.1 ∈ Deck q

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.map_conjHomeomorphMulEquiv_deck
decls.doc: The image of a deck group under over-base conjugation is the deck group over the target.
decls.statement:
lemma map_conjHomeomorphMulEquiv_deck (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) :
    (Deck p).map (conjHomeomorphMulEquiv h : (E ≃ₜ E) →* (F ≃ₜ F)) = Deck q

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjMulEquiv
decls.doc:
An isomorphism of maps over the same base identifies their deck transformation groups
by conjugation on the total spaces.
decls.statement: def conjMulEquiv (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) : Deck p ≃* Deck q

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjMulEquiv_apply_coe
decls.doc: The deck transformation produced by `conjMulEquiv` evaluates by conjugation.
decls.statement:
lemma conjMulEquiv_apply_coe (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (φ : Deck p) (f : F) :
    ((conjMulEquiv h hpq φ).1 f) = h (φ.1 (h.symm f))

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjMulEquiv_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc:
The inverse equivalence of `conjMulEquiv` is conjugation by the inverse
homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma conjMulEquiv_symm_apply_coe (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (ψ : Deck q) (e : E) :
    (((conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm ψ).1 e) = h.symm (ψ.1 (h e))

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjMulEquivRefl
decls.doc:
Conjugating deck transformations along the identity over-base homeomorphism gives the
identity deck-group equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma conjMulEquivRefl :
    conjMulEquiv (Homeomorph.refl E) (p := p) (q := p) (fun _ => rfl) =
      MulEquiv.refl (Deck p)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.conjMulEquivTrans
decls.doc:
Conjugating along a composite over-base homeomorphism is the composite of the two
conjugation equivalences.
decls.statement:
lemma conjMulEquivTrans (h : E ≃ₜ F) (k : F ≃ₜ G)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (hqr : ∀ f, r (k f) = q f) :
    conjMulEquiv (h.trans k) (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq]) =
      (conjMulEquiv h hpq).trans (conjMulEquiv k hqr)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroup_map_conj_refl
decls.doc: Conjugation by the identity over-base homeomorphism maps a subgroup to itself.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroup_map_conj_refl (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    H.map ((conjMulEquiv (Homeomorph.refl E) (p := p) (q := p)
      (fun e => by rfl) : Deck p ≃* Deck p) : Deck p →* Deck p) = H

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroup_map_conj_trans
decls.doc:
Mapping a subgroup through two successive conjugations agrees with mapping it through the
conjugation attached to the composite over-base homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroup_map_conj_trans (h : E ≃ₜ F) (k : F ≃ₜ G)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (hqr : ∀ f, r (k f) = q f) (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)).map
        ((conjMulEquiv k hqr : Deck q ≃* Deck r) : Deck q →* Deck r) =
      H.map ((conjMulEquiv (h.trans k)
        (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq]) : Deck p ≃* Deck r) :
          Deck p →* Deck r)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.eq_of_apply_eq
decls.doc:
Two deck transformations of a covering map with preconnected total space are equal if they
agree at one point of the total space.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_of_apply_eq [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (φ ψ : Deck p) {e : E}
    (h : φ.1 e = ψ.1 e) : φ = ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.eq_of_smul_eq_smul
decls.doc:
On a covering map with preconnected total space, equality of the ambient deck action at one
point determines the deck transformation.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_of_smul_eq_smul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (φ ψ : Deck p) {e : E}
    (h : φ • e = ψ • e) : φ = ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.isCancelSMul
decls.doc: The deck action on the total space of a preconnected covering is cancellative.
decls.statement: theorem isCancelSMul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) : IsCancelSMul (Deck p) E

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.stabilizer_eq_bot
decls.doc: The stabilizer of any point under the deck action of a preconnected covering is trivial.
decls.statement:
theorem stabilizer_eq_bot [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : E) :
    MulAction.stabilizer (Deck p) e = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.eq_of_fiber_smul_eq_fiber_smul
decls.doc:
A deck transformation of a preconnected covering is determined by its action on one point of
a chosen fibre.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_of_fiber_smul_eq_fiber_smul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (φ ψ : Deck p) {e : p ⁻¹' {b}} (h : φ • e = ψ • e) : φ = ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.eq_of_fiberHomeomorph_apply_eq
decls.doc:
A deck transformation of a preconnected covering is determined by the value of its
restricted fibre homeomorphism at one point.
decls.statement:
theorem eq_of_fiberHomeomorph_apply_eq [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (φ ψ : Deck p) {e : p ⁻¹' {b}} (h : fiberHomeomorph φ b e = fiberHomeomorph ψ b e) :
    φ = ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiber_isCancelSMul
decls.doc: The induced deck action on a fibre of a preconnected covering is cancellative.
decls.statement:
theorem fiber_isCancelSMul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) :
    IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiber_stabilizer_eq_bot
decls.doc:
The stabilizer of any fibre point under the restricted deck action of a preconnected
covering is trivial.
decls.statement:
theorem fiber_stabilizer_eq_bot [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    MulAction.stabilizer (Deck p) e = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorphHom_injective
decls.doc:
For a nonempty fibre of a preconnected covering, restricting deck transformations to that
fibre is injective.
decls.statement:
theorem fiberHomeomorphHom_injective [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    [Nonempty (p ⁻¹' {b})] : Function.Injective (fiberHomeomorphHom p b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorphHom_ker_eq_bot
decls.doc:
For a nonempty fibre of a preconnected covering, the homomorphism restricting deck
transformations to that fibre has trivial kernel.
decls.statement:
theorem fiberHomeomorphHom_ker_eq_bot [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    [Nonempty (p ⁻¹' {b})] : MonoidHom.ker (fiberHomeomorphHom p b) = ⊥

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitMap_injective
decls.doc: Evaluation at a point in a fibre is injective for a preconnected covering.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitMap_injective [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    Function.Injective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective
decls.doc:
For a preconnected covering whose orbit map at the chosen fibre point is surjective,
evaluation at that point identifies the deck group with that fibre.

This is the simply-transitive fibre action package used later when regular covers are
compared with normal subgroups and normalizer quotients.

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_apply
decls.doc:
The local equivalence from deck transformations to a fibre evaluates a deck
transformation at the chosen fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_apply [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) (φ : Deck p) :
    deckEquivFiberOfSurjective hp e hsurj φ = φ • e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_apply_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, the local deck-to-fibre equivalence is evaluation of the
underlying homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_apply_coe [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) (φ : Deck p) :
    (deckEquivFiberOfSurjective hp e hsurj φ : E) = φ.1 e.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_smul
decls.doc:
The inverse of `deckEquivFiberOfSurjective` is characterized by the deck transformation it
returns: it sends the chosen fibre point to the requested fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_smul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e)
    (e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (deckEquivFiberOfSurjective hp e hsurj).symm e' • e = e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, the inverse of `deckEquivFiberOfSurjective` sends the chosen point to
the requested point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_apply_coe [PreconnectedSpace E]
    (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b})
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) (e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (((deckEquivFiberOfSurjective hp e hsurj).symm e').1 e.1 : E) = e'.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_one
decls.doc: The local deck-to-fibre equivalence sends the identity to the chosen base point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_one [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) :
    deckEquivFiberOfSurjective hp e hsurj 1 = e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_mul
decls.doc:
The local deck-to-fibre equivalence is equivariant for left multiplication on the deck
group and the deck action on the fibre.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_mul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) (φ ψ : Deck p) :
    deckEquivFiberOfSurjective hp e hsurj (φ * ψ) =
      φ • deckEquivFiberOfSurjective hp e hsurj ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_apply_smul
decls.doc:
Translating a fibre point before applying the inverse local equivalence multiplies the
corresponding deck transformation on the left.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_apply_smul [PreconnectedSpace E]
    (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b})
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) (e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (deckEquivFiberOfSurjective hp e hsurj).symm (φ • e') =
      φ * (deckEquivFiberOfSurjective hp e hsurj).symm e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberTorsorOfPretransitive
decls.doc:
A nonempty pretransitive fibre of a preconnected covering is a torsor for its deck group.

The division `e₁ /ₛ e₂` is the unique deck transformation carrying `e₂` to `e₁`, expressed
using `deckEquivFiberOfSurjective` at the base point `e₂`.

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiber_sdiv_eq_deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm
decls.doc:
In the local fibre torsor, `e₁ /ₛ e₂` is the inverse local equivalence from `e₂` applied
to `e₁`.
decls.statement:
lemma fiber_sdiv_eq_deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm [PreconnectedSpace E]
    (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    [Nonempty (p ⁻¹' {b})] [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (e₁ e₂ : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    letI

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_eq_sdiv
decls.doc:
In the local fibre torsor, the inverse of `deckEquivFiberOfSurjective` computes the
quotient of a point by the chosen base point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_eq_sdiv [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    [Nonempty (p ⁻¹' {b})] [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    letI

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorphHom
decls.doc:
The homomorphism from deck transformations to homeomorphisms of the fibre over `b`.

It sends a deck transformation to its restriction to the subtype `p ⁻¹' {b}`.
decls.statement: def fiberHomeomorphHom (p : E → B) (b : B) : Deck p →* (p ⁻¹' {b} ≃ₜ p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorphHom_apply
decls.doc:
The fibre homomorphism evaluates by applying the deck transformation to the underlying
point of the fibre.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorphHom_apply (φ : Deck p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberHomeomorphHom p b φ e = fiberHomeomorph φ b e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorphHom_apply_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, the fibre homomorphism is evaluation of the underlying
homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorphHom_apply_coe (φ : Deck p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (fiberHomeomorphHom p b φ e : E) = φ.1 e.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorphHom_one
decls.doc:
The fibre homomorphism sends the identity deck transformation to the identity
homeomorphism of the fibre.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorphHom_one :
    fiberHomeomorphHom p b (1 : Deck p) = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorphHom_mul
decls.doc:
The fibre homomorphism sends products of deck transformations to products of fibre
homeomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorphHom_mul (φ ψ : Deck p) :
    fiberHomeomorphHom p b (φ * ψ) = fiberHomeomorphHom p b φ * fiberHomeomorphHom p b ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorphHom_inv
decls.doc:
The fibre homomorphism sends inverses of deck transformations to inverses of fibre
homeomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorphHom_inv (φ : Deck p) :
    fiberHomeomorphHom p b φ⁻¹ = (fiberHomeomorphHom p b φ)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorph_one
decls.doc: The fibre homeomorphism associated to the identity deck transformation is the identity.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorph_one :
    fiberHomeomorph (1 : Deck p) b = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorph_mul
decls.doc:
The fibre homeomorphism associated to a product is the product of the associated fibre
homeomorphisms.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorph_mul (φ ψ : Deck p) :
    fiberHomeomorph (φ * ψ) b = fiberHomeomorph φ b * fiberHomeomorph ψ b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorph_inv
decls.doc:
The fibre homeomorphism associated to an inverse is the inverse of the associated fibre
homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorph_inv (φ : Deck p) :
    fiberHomeomorph φ⁻¹ b = (fiberHomeomorph φ b)⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorph_pow
decls.doc:
The fibre homeomorphism associated to a natural-number power is the corresponding power
of the associated fibre homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorph_pow (φ : Deck p) (n : ℕ) :
    fiberHomeomorph (φ ^ n) b = fiberHomeomorph φ b ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorph_zpow
decls.doc:
The fibre homeomorphism associated to an integer power is the corresponding power of the
associated fibre homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorph_zpow (φ : Deck p) (n : ℤ) :
    fiberHomeomorph (φ ^ n) b = fiberHomeomorph φ b ^ n

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.instFiberMulAction
decls.doc: Deck transformations act on each fibre by restricting their action on the total space.
decls.statement: instance instFiberMulAction : MulAction (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiber_smul_eq_fiberHomeomorph
decls.doc: The fibre action is evaluation of the fibre homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiber_smul_eq_fiberHomeomorph (φ : Deck p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    φ • e = fiberHomeomorph φ b e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiber_smul_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, the fibre action is evaluation of the underlying deck
transformation.
decls.statement:
lemma fiber_smul_coe (φ : Deck p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    ((φ • e : p ⁻¹' {b}) : E) = φ.1 e.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.map_fiber_smul
decls.doc:
The projection value of a point in the fibre is unchanged after the restricted deck
action.
decls.statement:
lemma map_fiber_smul (φ : Deck p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    p (φ • e : E) = b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiber_smul_mem
decls.doc: The restricted deck action keeps points in the fibre over `b`.
decls.statement:
lemma fiber_smul_mem (φ : Deck p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (φ • e : E) ∈ p ⁻¹' {b}

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiber_smul_coe_eq_smul
decls.doc:
The restricted fibre action agrees with the ambient action on the total space after
coercing out of the fibre subtype.
decls.statement:
lemma fiber_smul_coe_eq_smul (φ : Deck p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    ((φ • e : p ⁻¹' {b}) : E) = φ • (e : E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.mem_fiber_stabilizer_iff_coe
decls.doc: Membership in the stabilizer of a fibre point is equality on the underlying point.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_fiber_stabilizer_iff_coe (φ : Deck p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    φ ∈ MulAction.stabilizer (Deck p) e ↔ φ.1 e.1 = e.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.FiberOrbitQuotient
decls.doc: The quotient of the fibre over `b` by the restricted action of the deck group.
decls.statement: abbrev FiberOrbitQuotient (p : E → B) (b : B) : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberOrbitClass
decls.doc: The deck orbit class of a point in one fibre.
decls.statement: def fiberOrbitClass (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) : FiberOrbitQuotient p b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberOrbitClass_eq_mk
decls.doc: The deck-orbit quotient map sends a fibre point to its own class.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberOrbitClass_eq_mk (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberOrbitClass e = (Quotient.mk'' e : FiberOrbitQuotient p b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberOrbitClass_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Two fibre points have the same deck-orbit class exactly when they lie in the same deck
orbit. This uses the orientation of `MulAction.orbitRel_apply`: the left point is a member of
the orbit of the right point.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberOrbitClass_eq_iff (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberOrbitClass e = fiberOrbitClass e' ↔ e ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck p) e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv
decls.doc: An over-base homeomorphism identifies deck-orbit quotients of corresponding fibres.
decls.statement:
def fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (b : B) :
    FiberOrbitQuotient p b ≃ FiberOrbitQuotient q b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The induced equivalence on fibre-orbit quotients sends the class of a point to the class
of its transported point.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_apply (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq b (fiberOrbitClass e) =
      fiberOrbitClass (fiberMap h hpq b e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse induced equivalence on fibre-orbit quotients sends the class of a target
fibre point to the class of its inverse transport.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_symm_apply (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (f : q ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq b).symm (fiberOrbitClass f) =
      fiberOrbitClass ((fiberMap h hpq b).symm f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_refl
decls.doc: The identity over-base homeomorphism induces the identity on fibre-orbit quotients.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_refl :
    fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (Homeomorph.refl E) (p := p) (q := p)
        (fun e => by rfl) b =
      Equiv.refl (FiberOrbitQuotient p b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_trans
decls.doc:
Fibre-orbit quotient equivalences compose as the underlying over-base homeomorphisms
compose.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_trans (h : E ≃ₜ F) (k : F ≃ₜ G)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (hqr : ∀ f, r (k f) = q f) :
    fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (h.trans k) (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq]) b =
      (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq b).trans (fiberOrbitQuotientEquiv k hqr b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.isRegular_iff_surjective_subsingleton_fiberOrbitQuotient
decls.doc:
Regularity can be read from the orbit quotients of the fibre actions: the map is
surjective, and each fibre has at most one deck orbit.
decls.statement:
lemma isRegular_iff_surjective_subsingleton_fiberOrbitQuotient :
    IsRegular p ↔ Function.Surjective p ∧ ∀ b : B, Subsingleton (FiberOrbitQuotient p b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.subsingleton_fiberOrbitQuotient
decls.doc: A regular deck action has a subsingleton quotient of each fibre by deck orbits.
decls.statement:
lemma subsingleton_fiberOrbitQuotient (hreg : IsRegular p) (b : B) :
    Subsingleton (FiberOrbitQuotient p b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.fiberOrbitClass_eq
decls.doc: For a regular deck action, all points in the same fibre have the same deck-orbit class.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberOrbitClass_eq (hreg : IsRegular p) (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberOrbitClass e = fiberOrbitClass e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.isPretransitive_fiberMap
decls.doc:
Fibre transport carries a pretransitive deck action on the source fibre to a pretransitive
deck action on the target fibre.
decls.statement:
lemma isPretransitive_fiberMap (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] :
    MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck q) (q ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.surjective_smul_fiberMap
decls.doc:
Fibre transport carries surjectivity of evaluation at a source fibre point to surjectivity
of evaluation at the transported target fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma surjective_smul_fiberMap (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) :
    Function.Surjective fun ψ : Deck q => ψ • fiberMap h hpq b e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_fiberMap
decls.doc:
The inverse of the local deck-to-fibre equivalence is compatible with fibre transport:
transport the target fibre point first, or compute the source deck transformation first and
then conjugate it.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_symm_fiberMap [PreconnectedSpace E]
    (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hq : IsCoveringMap q) (h : E ≃ₜ F)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b})
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) :
    letI : PreconnectedSpace F

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_sdiv_eq_conjMulEquiv_of_pretransitive
decls.doc:
Fibre transport preserves torsor division, with the deck-group element transported by
conjugation along the over-base homeomorphism.

This is the local pretransitive-fibre form. The regular-cover API below supplies the
nonemptiness and pretransitivity hypotheses from `Deck.IsRegular`.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_sdiv_eq_conjMulEquiv_of_pretransitive [PreconnectedSpace E]
    (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hq : IsCoveringMap q)
    [Nonempty (p ⁻¹' {b})] [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e₁ e₂ : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    letI : PreconnectedSpace F

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_fiberMap
decls.doc:
The local deck-to-fibre equivalence commutes with transport of deck transformations
and fibre points along an over-base homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_fiberMap [PreconnectedSpace E]
    (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hq : IsCoveringMap q) (h : E ≃ₜ F)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e : p ⁻¹' {b})
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) (φ : Deck p) :

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_fiberMap_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, local compatibility of `deckEquivFiberOfSurjective` with fibre
transport says that conjugating a deck transformation and then evaluating on the transported

decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiberOfSurjective_fiberMap_coe [PreconnectedSpace E]

    (hsurj : Function.Surjective fun φ : Deck p => φ • e) (φ : Deck p) :

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber_symm_fiberMap
decls.doc:
The inverse of the regular deck-to-fibre equivalence is compatible with fibre transport:

decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_symm_fiberMap [PreconnectedSpace E]

    letI : PreconnectedSpace F

decls.statement:

decls.doc:

decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_fiberMap_coe [PreconnectedSpace E]
