    letI : PreconnectedSpace F

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_sdiv_eq_conjMulEquiv
decls.doc:
For regular preconnected covers, fibre transport preserves torsor division, with the
deck transformation conjugated to the target deck group.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_sdiv_eq_conjMulEquiv [PreconnectedSpace E]
    (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hq : IsCoveringMap q) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e₁ e₂ : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    letI : PreconnectedSpace F

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap
decls.doc:
An over-base homeomorphism identifies the fibre over `b` for `p` with the fibre over
`b` for `q`.
decls.statement:
def fiberMap (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (b : B) :
    p ⁻¹' {b} ≃ₜ q ⁻¹' {b}

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_apply_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, the fibre map induced by an over-base homeomorphism is just that
homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_apply_coe (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (fiberMap h hpq b e : F) = h e.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, the inverse fibre map is the inverse of the over-base
homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_symm_apply_coe (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (f : q ⁻¹' {b}) :
    ((fiberMap h hpq b).symm f : E) = h.symm f.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_refl
decls.doc: The fibre map induced by the identity over-base homeomorphism is the identity.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_refl :
    fiberMap (Homeomorph.refl E) (p := p) (q := p) (fun _ => rfl) b =
      Homeomorph.refl (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_symm
decls.doc:
The inverse of the fibre map induced by an over-base homeomorphism is the fibre map induced
by the inverse over-base homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_symm (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) :
    (fiberMap h hpq b).symm =
      fiberMap h.symm (map_symm_eq_of_map_eq h hpq) b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_trans
decls.doc: Fibre maps compose as the underlying over-base homeomorphisms compose.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_trans (h : E ≃ₜ F) (k : F ≃ₜ G)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (hqr : ∀ f, r (k f) = q f) :
    (fiberMap h hpq b).trans (fiberMap k hqr b) =
      fiberMap (h.trans k) (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq]) b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_smul
decls.doc:
Fibre transport intertwines the restricted deck action with conjugation of deck
transformations.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_smul (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (φ : Deck p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberMap h hpq b (φ • e) = conjMulEquiv h hpq φ • fiberMap h hpq b e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_symm_smul
decls.doc:
The inverse fibre transport intertwines the restricted deck action with inverse
conjugation of deck transformations.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_symm_smul (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (ψ : Deck q)
    (f : q ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (fiberMap h hpq b).symm (ψ • f) =
      (conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm ψ • (fiberMap h hpq b).symm f

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_trans_fiberHomeomorph
decls.doc:
Transporting a deck transformation to the target cover and then restricting it to a fibre
is the same as restricting first and conjugating the resulting fibre homeomorphism by the fibre
transport map.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_trans_fiberHomeomorph (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (φ : Deck p) :
    (fiberMap h hpq b).trans (fiberHomeomorph (conjMulEquiv h hpq φ) b) =
      (fiberHomeomorph φ b).trans (fiberMap h hpq b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberHomeomorphHom_conjMulEquiv
decls.doc:
Restricting conjugated deck transformations to a fibre is compatible with the fibre
restriction homomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberHomeomorphHom_conjMulEquiv (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (φ : Deck p) :
    fiberHomeomorphHom q b (conjMulEquiv h hpq φ) =
      (fiberMap h hpq b).symm.trans ((fiberHomeomorphHom p b φ).trans (fiberMap h hpq b))

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.mem_stabilizer_conjMulEquiv_fiberMap_iff
decls.doc: Conjugation transports stabilizer membership along the fibre map.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_stabilizer_conjMulEquiv_fiberMap_iff (h : E ≃ₜ F)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (φ : Deck p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    conjMulEquiv h hpq φ ∈ MulAction.stabilizer (Deck q) (fiberMap h hpq b e) ↔
      φ ∈ MulAction.stabilizer (Deck p) e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.map_fiber_stabilizer_conjMulEquiv
decls.doc:
Conjugation maps the source fibre stabilizer onto the transported target fibre
stabilizer.
decls.statement:
theorem map_fiber_stabilizer_conjMulEquiv (h : E ≃ₜ F)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (MulAction.stabilizer (Deck p) e).map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) :
        Deck p →* Deck q) =
      MulAction.stabilizer (Deck q) (fiberMap h hpq b e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMapStabilizerEquiv
decls.doc: Fibre transport identifies stabilizers, using conjugation on deck transformations.
decls.statement:
def fiberMapStabilizerEquiv (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    MulAction.stabilizer (Deck p) e ≃*
      MulAction.stabilizer (Deck q) (fiberMap h hpq b e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMapStabilizerEquiv_apply_coe
decls.doc: On deck transformations, the fibre-map stabilizer equivalence is conjugation.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMapStabilizerEquiv_apply_coe (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : MulAction.stabilizer (Deck p) e) :
    (fiberMapStabilizerEquiv h hpq e φ : Deck q) = conjMulEquiv h hpq φ.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMapStabilizerEquiv_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc:
On deck transformations, the inverse fibre-map stabilizer equivalence is inverse
conjugation.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMapStabilizerEquiv_symm_apply_coe (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (ψ : MulAction.stabilizer (Deck q) (fiberMap h hpq b e)) :
    ((fiberMapStabilizerEquiv h hpq e).symm ψ : Deck p) =
      (conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm ψ.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_mem_orbit
decls.doc:
Applying a deck transformation and then transporting to the target fibre gives a point in
the target deck orbit.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_mem_orbit (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (φ : Deck p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberMap h hpq b (φ • e) ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck q) (fiberMap h hpq b e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_image_orbit
decls.doc:
The fibre map carries the deck orbit of a point onto the deck orbit of the transported
point.
decls.statement:
theorem fiberMap_image_orbit (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberMap h hpq b '' MulAction.orbit (Deck p) e =
      MulAction.orbit (Deck q) (fiberMap h hpq b e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_symm_mem_orbit
decls.doc:
Applying a deck transformation and then transporting back to the source fibre gives a
point in the source deck orbit.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_symm_mem_orbit (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (ψ : Deck q)
    (f : q ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (fiberMap h hpq b).symm (ψ • f) ∈
      MulAction.orbit (Deck p) ((fiberMap h hpq b).symm f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_symm_image_orbit
decls.doc:
The inverse fibre map carries the deck orbit of a point onto the deck orbit of the
transported point.
decls.statement:
theorem fiberMap_symm_image_orbit (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (f : q ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (fiberMap h hpq b).symm '' MulAction.orbit (Deck q) f =
      MulAction.orbit (Deck p) ((fiberMap h hpq b).symm f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.mem_orbit_fiberMap_iff
decls.doc: Transporting both fibre points preserves membership in deck orbits.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_orbit_fiberMap_iff (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberMap h hpq b e' ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck q) (fiberMap h hpq b e) ↔
      e' ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck p) e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.mem_orbit_fiberMap_symm_iff
decls.doc: Transporting both target-fibre points back preserves membership in deck orbits.
decls.statement:
theorem mem_orbit_fiberMap_symm_iff (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (f f' : q ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (fiberMap h hpq b).symm f' ∈
        MulAction.orbit (Deck p) ((fiberMap h hpq b).symm f) ↔
      f' ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck q) f

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv
decls.doc:
For a regular covering map `p : E → X` with simply connected total space, the fundamental
group of the base is anti-isomorphic to the deck transformation group:
`FundamentalGroup X x ≃* (Deck p)ᵐᵒᵖ`. The `ᵐᵒᵖ` reflects that the deck group acts on the
left while the monodromy of `π₁` acts on the right; see the module docstring.
decls.statement:
def IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) :
    FundamentalGroup X x ≃* (Deck p)ᵐᵒᵖ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_unop_apply
decls.doc:
The deck transformation attached to a loop class `γ` moves the chosen basepoint lift `e`
along the monodromy of `γ`.
decls.statement:
lemma IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_unop_apply [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) (γ : FundamentalGroup X x) :
    (hreg.fundamentalGroupEquiv hp e γ).unop.1 (e : E) = (hp.monodromy γ e : E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_unop_smul
decls.doc: Compatibility spelling of `fundamentalGroupEquiv_unop_apply` using the deck action.
decls.statement:
lemma IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_unop_smul [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) (γ : FundamentalGroup X x) :
    (hreg.fundamentalGroupEquiv hp e γ).unop • (e : E) = hp.monodromy γ e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_apply_eq_iff
decls.doc:
The fundamental group element `γ` corresponds to a deck transformation `g` exactly when
`g.unop` moves the chosen lift `e` to the monodromy translate of `e` along `γ`.
decls.statement:
lemma IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_apply_eq_iff [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x})
    (γ : FundamentalGroup X x) (g : (Deck p)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    hreg.fundamentalGroupEquiv hp e γ = g ↔
      g.unop • (e : E) = hp.monodromy γ e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_symm_monodromy
decls.doc:
The fundamental group element corresponding to an opposite deck transformation is the
unique loop class whose monodromy moves the chosen lift `e` by that deck transformation.
decls.statement:
lemma IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_symm_monodromy [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) (g : (Deck p)ᵐᵒᵖ) :
    (hp.monodromy ((hreg.fundamentalGroupEquiv hp e).symm g) e : E) = g.unop • (e : E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_symm_op_monodromy
decls.doc:
A `Deck p` spelling of `fundamentalGroupEquiv_symm_monodromy`. The loop class
corresponding to `MulOpposite.op φ` has monodromy action equal to `φ` at the chosen lift.
decls.statement:
lemma IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_symm_op_monodromy [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (hp.monodromy ((hreg.fundamentalGroupEquiv hp e).symm (MulOpposite.op φ)) e : E) =
      φ • (e : E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
A loop class `γ` maps to the identity deck transformation exactly when its monodromy
fixes the chosen basepoint lift `e`.
decls.statement:
lemma IsRegular.fundamentalGroupEquiv_eq_one_iff [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) (γ : FundamentalGroup X x) :
    hreg.fundamentalGroupEquiv hp e γ = 1 ↔ hp.monodromy γ e = e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv
decls.doc:
For a regular covering map `p : E → X` with simply connected total space, the deck group
is isomorphic to the opposite of the fundamental group of the base:
`Deck p ≃* (FundamentalGroup X x)ᵐᵒᵖ`.

The opposite is the same convention as in `fundamentalGroupEquiv`: deck transformations act
on the left, while fundamental-group monodromy acts on the right.
decls.statement:
def deckFundamentalGroupEquiv [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) :
    Deck p ≃* (FundamentalGroup X x)ᵐᵒᵖ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The deck-to-fundamental-group equivalence sends a deck transformation to the opposite
of the loop class corresponding to the opposite deck transformation under
`fundamentalGroupEquiv`.
decls.statement:
lemma deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_apply [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) (φ : Deck p) :
    hreg.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv hp e φ =
      MulOpposite.op ((hreg.fundamentalGroupEquiv hp e).symm (MulOpposite.op φ))

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_symm_op
decls.doc:
The inverse deck-to-fundamental-group equivalence sends `op γ` to the deck
transformation corresponding to `γ` under `fundamentalGroupEquiv`.
decls.statement:
lemma deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_symm_op [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x})
    (γ : FundamentalGroup X x) :
    (hreg.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv hp e).symm (MulOpposite.op γ) =
      (hreg.fundamentalGroupEquiv hp e γ).unop

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_unop_monodromy
decls.doc:
The loop class attached to a deck transformation has monodromy equal to that deck
transformation on the chosen lift.
decls.statement:
lemma deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_unop_monodromy [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (hp.monodromy ((hreg.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv hp e φ).unop) e : E) = φ • (e : E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_apply_eq_op_iff
decls.doc:
A deck transformation corresponds to a loop class exactly when that loop class's
monodromy moves the chosen lift by the deck transformation.
decls.statement:
lemma deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_apply_eq_op_iff [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x})
    (φ : Deck p) (γ : FundamentalGroup X x) :
    hreg.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv hp e φ = MulOpposite.op γ ↔
      (hp.monodromy γ e : E) = φ • (e : E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_symm_op_eq_iff
decls.doc: The inverse comparison is characterized by the same monodromy formula.
decls.statement:
lemma deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_symm_op_eq_iff [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x})
    (γ : FundamentalGroup X x) (φ : Deck p) :
    (hreg.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv hp e).symm (MulOpposite.op γ) = φ ↔
      (hp.monodromy γ e : E) = φ • (e : E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_eq_one_iff
decls.doc:
A deck transformation maps to the identity loop class exactly when it fixes the chosen
lift.
decls.statement:
lemma deckFundamentalGroupEquiv_eq_one_iff [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) (φ : Deck p) :
    hreg.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv hp e φ = 1 ↔ φ • (e : E) = e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.deckEquivFiber_eq_fundamentalGroupEquivFiber
decls.doc:
Under the deck-to-fundamental-group comparison, the deck-to-fibre equivalence for a
regular cover agrees with the monodromy equivalence from `π₁` to the same fibre.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_eq_fundamentalGroupEquivFiber [SimplyConnectedSpace E]
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {x}) (φ : Deck p) :
    deckEquivFiber hp hreg e φ =
      TauCeti.IsCoveringMap.fundamentalGroupEquivFiber hp e
        ((hreg.deckFundamentalGroupEquiv hp e φ).unop)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal
decls.doc:
For a normal subgroup `H ≤ Deck p`, the quotient of a fibre by the restricted `H`-action
is the normalizer quotient `N(H) / H`, once the deck action on the fibre is free and
transitive.

Under normality, `N(H) = Deck p`, so this is the fibre-level version of the regular-cover
specialization from `N(H) / H` to `Deck p / H`.
decls.statement:
def subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) [H.Normal] (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b ≃ Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal
decls.doc:
For a regular preconnected covering and a normal subgroup `H ≤ Deck p`, the quotient of a
fibre by the restricted `H`-action is the normalizer quotient `N(H) / H`.
decls.statement:
def regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) [H.Normal] (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b ≃ Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv
decls.doc:
The normal-subgroup fibre quotient equivalence, followed by the normalizer quotient's
normal-case comparison, is the existing equivalence to `Deck p ⧸ H`.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal_subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) [H.Normal] (e : p ⁻¹' {b})
    (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) :
    Subgroup.normalizerQuotientEquivQuotientOfNormal H
        (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal H e x) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup H e x

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal_map_smul_eq_mul_inv
decls.doc:
Under the normal-subgroup fibre quotient equivalence, the descended normalizer-quotient
action is right multiplication by the inverse. This is the representative-free form of the
convention that `φ • e` maps to the class of `φ⁻¹`.

lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal_map_smul_eq_mul_inv

    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal H e (a • x) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal H e x * a⁻¹

decls.doc:
For a regular preconnected covering map, the normal-subgroup fibre quotient equivalence

decls.statement:

decls.doc:

      a • (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal H e).symm y

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal_symm_mul_inv

    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) [H.Normal] (e : p ⁻¹' {b})
    (a y : Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) :
    (regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivNormalizerQuotientOfNormal hp hreg H e).symm
