decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientConjEquiv
decls.doc:
Conjugating an over-base homeomorphism identifies the normalizer quotient of a deck
subgroup with the normalizer quotient of the conjugated subgroup.
decls.statement:
abbrev normalizerQuotientConjEquiv (h : E ≃ₜ F)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H ≃*
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotient
        (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_mk
decls.doc:
On normalizer representatives, the deck normalizer-quotient conjugation equivalence is
induced by conjugating deck transformations.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_mk (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) :
    normalizerQuotientConjEquiv h hpq H (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H φ) =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk
        (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
        (Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap H (conjMulEquiv h hpq) φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_refl_mk_congr
decls.doc:
After the subgroup equality induced by identity conjugation, conjugating the normalizer
quotient by the identity over-base homeomorphism is the canonical identity on representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_refl_mk_congr (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) :
    Subgroup.normalizerQuotientCongr (subgroup_map_conj_refl (p := p) H)
      (normalizerQuotientConjEquiv (Homeomorph.refl E) (p := p) (q := p)
        (fun e => by rfl : ∀ e, p ((Homeomorph.refl E) e) = p e) H
        (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H φ)) =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H φ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_symm_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse deck normalizer-quotient conjugation equivalence is induced by inverse
conjugation of deck transformations.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_symm_mk (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (ψ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer
      ((H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) :
        Set (Deck q))) :
    (normalizerQuotientConjEquiv h hpq H).symm
        (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk
          (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) ψ) =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H
        ((Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap H (conjMulEquiv h hpq)).symm ψ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_trans_mk
decls.doc:
Composing two deck normalizer-quotient conjugation equivalences sends representatives through
the two successive conjugation transports.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_trans_mk
    {G : Type*} [TopologicalSpace G] {r : G → B}
    (h : E ≃ₜ F) (k : F ≃ₜ G)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (hqr : ∀ f, r (k f) = q f)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) :
    normalizerQuotientConjEquiv k hqr
        (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
        (normalizerQuotientConjEquiv h hpq H (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H φ)) =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk
        ((H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)).map
          ((conjMulEquiv k hqr : Deck q ≃* Deck r) : Deck q →* Deck r))
        (Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap
          (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
          (conjMulEquiv k hqr)
          (Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap H (conjMulEquiv h hpq) φ))

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_trans_mk_congr
decls.doc:
After identifying the twice-conjugated subgroup with the subgroup conjugated by the
composite over-base homeomorphism, composing deck normalizer-quotient conjugation equivalences
agrees with conjugation by the composite on representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_trans_mk_congr
    {G : Type*} [TopologicalSpace G] {r : G → B}
    (h : E ≃ₜ F) (k : F ≃ₜ G)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (hqr : ∀ f, r (k f) = q f)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) :
    Subgroup.normalizerQuotientCongr (subgroup_map_conj_trans h k hpq hqr H)
      (normalizerQuotientConjEquiv k hqr
        (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
        (normalizerQuotientConjEquiv h hpq H (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H φ))) =
      normalizerQuotientConjEquiv (h.trans k)
        (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq]) H
        (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H φ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_symm_mk'
decls.doc:
Inverse-conjugating a representative of the `h`-conjugated subgroup quotient gives the
stated representative in the twice-mapped subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_symm_mk' (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (ψ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer
      ((H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) :
        Set (Deck q))) :
    normalizerQuotientConjEquiv h.symm (map_symm_eq_of_map_eq h hpq)
        (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
        (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk
          (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) ψ) =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk
        ((H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)).map
          ((conjMulEquiv h.symm (map_symm_eq_of_map_eq h hpq) : Deck q ≃* Deck p) :
            Deck q →* Deck p))
        (Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap
          (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
          (conjMulEquiv h.symm (map_symm_eq_of_map_eq h hpq)) ψ)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_mk_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying deck transformations, the normalizer representative in the target quotient
is obtained by conjugation.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_mk_coe (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) :
    normalizerQuotientConjEquiv h hpq H (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H φ) =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk
        (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
        ⟨conjMulEquiv h hpq (φ : Deck p), by
          rw [← Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_apply_coe H (conjMulEquiv h hpq) φ]
          exact (Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap H (conjMulEquiv h hpq) φ).2⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_symm_mk_coe
decls.doc:
On representatives, inverse transport of the deck normalizer quotient applies inverse
conjugation.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientConjEquiv_symm_mk_coe (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (ψ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer
      ((H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) :
        Set (Deck q))) :
    (normalizerQuotientConjEquiv h hpq H).symm
        (Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk
          (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) ψ) =
      Subgroup.normalizerQuotientMk H
        ⟨(conjMulEquiv h hpq).symm (ψ : Deck q), by
          rw [← Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap_symm_apply_coe H (conjMulEquiv h hpq) ψ]
          exact ((Subgroup.normalizerEquivMap H (conjMulEquiv h hpq)).symm ψ).2⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap
decls.doc: A normalizer representative acts on the quotient of one fibre by `H`-orbits.

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap_apply
decls.doc:
The normalizer action on fibre quotients sends the class of a point to the class of its
deck translate.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap_apply (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap H φ (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H ((φ : Deck p) • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap_one
decls.doc: The normalizer representative `1` acts trivially on the subgroup fibre quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap_one (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap (b := b) H ⟨1, by simp⟩ = id

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap_mul
decls.doc: Normalizer representatives act by composition on the subgroup fibre quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap_mul (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ ψ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) :
    normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap (b := b) H (φ * ψ) =
      normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap H φ ∘ normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitMap H ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitEquiv
decls.doc: A normalizer representative acts on the subgroup fibre quotient by a permutation.

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
A normalizer representative permutes the subgroup fibre quotient by translating
representatives.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitEquiv_apply (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitEquiv H φ (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H ((φ : Deck p) • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse normalizer permutation translates fibre-orbit representatives by the inverse
deck transformation.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitEquiv_symm_apply (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitEquiv H φ).symm (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H ((φ : Deck p)⁻¹ • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom
decls.doc: The normalizer action on the subgroup fibre quotient as a permutation representation.

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom_apply
decls.doc:
The normalizer permutation homomorphism sends representatives to the expected deck
translate on fibre-orbit classes.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom_apply (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom (b := b) H φ (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H ((φ : Deck p) • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom_eq_one_of_mem
decls.doc:
Any normalizer representative whose underlying deck transformation lies in `H` maps to
the identity permutation on the quotient of each fibre by `H`-orbits.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom_eq_one_of_mem
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p)))
    (hφ : (φ : Deck p) ∈ H) :
    normalizerSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom (b := b) H φ = 1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom
decls.doc: The action of the normalizer on subgroup fibre quotients descends to `N(H) / H`.
decls.statement:
def normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H →*
      Equiv.Perm (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom_mk_apply
decls.doc:
The descended normalizer-quotient action sends a normalizer representative to the
corresponding deck translate on fibre-orbit classes.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom_mk_apply (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitPermHom (b := b) H
        (φ : Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H ((φ : Deck p) • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.instNormalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitMulAction
decls.doc: The normalizer quotient `N(H) / H` acts on the quotient of a fibre by `H`-orbits.
decls.statement:
instance instNormalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitMulAction
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    MulAction (Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotient_smul_subgroupFiberOrbitClass
decls.doc: Representative formula for the action of `N(H) / H` on subgroup fibre quotients.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotient_smul_subgroupFiberOrbitClass (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (φ : _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (φ : Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) • subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H ((φ : Deck p) • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotient_one_smul_subgroupFiberOrbitClass
decls.doc: The identity class in `N(H) / H` fixes every subgroup fibre-orbit class.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotient_one_smul_subgroupFiberOrbitClass (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (1 : Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) • subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotient_mk_of_mem_smul_subgroupFiberOrbitClass
decls.doc: A representative from `H` acts trivially through the normalizer quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotient_mk_of_mem_smul_subgroupFiberOrbitClass
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (φ : Deck p) (hφ : φ ∈ H) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    ((⟨φ, _root_.Subgroup.le_normalizer hφ⟩ :
          _root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) :
        Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) •
        subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitive
decls.doc:
If the normalizer of `H` acts transitively on the chosen fibre, then the descended
`N(H) / H` action on the quotient of that fibre by `H`-orbits is transitive.
decls.statement:
theorem normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitive
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (_root_.Subgroup.normalizer (H : Set (Deck p))) (p ⁻¹' {b})] :
    MulAction.IsPretransitive
      (Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal
decls.doc:
If `H` is normal and the deck action on the chosen fibre is transitive, then the
descended `N(H) / H` action on the quotient of that fibre by `H`-orbits is transitive.
decls.statement:
theorem normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) [H.Normal] :
    MulAction.IsPretransitive
      (Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.instNormalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal
decls.doc:
The normalizer quotient acts transitively on a normal subgroup fibre quotient whenever the
deck action on the fibre is transitive.
decls.statement:
instance instNormalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) [H.Normal] :
    MulAction.IsPretransitive
      (Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal_of_isRegular
decls.doc:
For a regular map and a normal deck subgroup, the descended `N(H) / H` action on each
subgroup fibre quotient is transitive. This is the fibre-action half of the regular-cover
specialization from the normalizer quotient to an ordinary quotient by a normal subgroup.
decls.statement:
theorem normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsPretransitiveOfNormal_of_isRegular
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) [H.Normal] :
    MulAction.IsPretransitive
      (Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotient_smul_subgroupFiberOrbit_eq_smul_iff
decls.doc:
Equality after the `N(H) / H` action on an `H`-fibre quotient is equality of
normalizer-quotient elements, provided the deck action on that fibre is free.
decls.statement:
lemma normalizerQuotient_smul_subgroupFiberOrbit_eq_smul_iff
    [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (a c : Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) :
    a • x = c • x ↔ a = c

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.instNormalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsCancelSMul
decls.doc:
If the deck action on a fibre is free, then the descended `N(H) / H` action on the
quotient of that fibre by `H`-orbits is free.
decls.statement:
instance instNormalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsCancelSMul
    [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    IsCancelSMul (Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsCancelSMulOfIsCoveringMap
decls.doc:
For a preconnected covering map, the descended `N(H) / H` action on every `H`-fibre
quotient is free.
decls.statement:
theorem normalizerQuotientSubgroupFiberOrbitIsCancelSMulOfIsCoveringMap
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    IsCancelSMul (Subgroup.normalizerQuotient H) (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.eq_proj_of_orbitRel
decls.doc: Points in the same deck orbit have the same projection under `p`.
decls.statement:
lemma eq_proj_of_orbitRel {e e' : E} (h : MulAction.orbitRel (Deck p) E e e') :
    p e = p e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitQuotientToBase
decls.doc: The projection map factors through the quotient of `E` by deck orbits.
decls.statement: def orbitQuotientToBase (p : E → B) : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E → B

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitQuotientToBase_mk
decls.doc: The map from the deck-orbit quotient to the base evaluates on representatives by `p`.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientToBase_mk (e : E) :
    orbitQuotientToBase p (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) =
      p e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitRel_eq_ker_of_exists_apply_eq
decls.doc:
If deck orbits are exactly fibres of `p`, the deck-orbit relation is the kernel relation
of `p`.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRel_eq_ker_of_exists_apply_eq
    (hpoint : ∀ {e e' : E}, p e = p e' → ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e') :
    MulAction.orbitRel (Deck p) E = Setoid.ker p

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.apply_eq_iff_mem_orbit_of_exists_apply_eq
decls.doc:
If every pair of points with the same projection is connected by a deck transformation,
then two points of the total space have the same projection exactly when they lie in a common
orbit of the deck transformation group. The reverse direction holds because deck
transformations preserve the projection.
decls.statement:
lemma apply_eq_iff_mem_orbit_of_exists_apply_eq
    (hpoint : ∀ {e e' : E}, p e = p e' → ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e') {e₁ e₂ : E} :
    p e₁ = p e₂ ↔ e₁ ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck p) e₂

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitRel_homeomorph_iff
decls.doc: An over-base homeomorphism preserves the corresponding deck-orbit relations.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitRel_homeomorph_iff (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e e' : E) :
    MulAction.orbitRel (Deck p) E e e' ↔
      MulAction.orbitRel (Deck q) F (h e) (h e')

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitQuotientEquiv
decls.doc: An over-base homeomorphism identifies the corresponding deck-orbit quotients.
decls.statement:
def orbitQuotientEquiv (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) :
    MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E ≃ MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck q) F

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitQuotientEquiv_mk
decls.doc:
The over-base equivalence on orbit quotients evaluates on representatives by the
homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientEquiv_mk (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (e : E) :
    orbitQuotientEquiv h hpq
      (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) =
        (Quotient.mk'' (h e) : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck q) F)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitQuotientEquiv_symm_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse over-base equivalence on orbit quotients evaluates on representatives by the
inverse homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientEquiv_symm_mk (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (f : F) :
    (orbitQuotientEquiv h hpq).symm
      (Quotient.mk'' f : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck q) F) =
        (Quotient.mk'' (h.symm f) : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitQuotientToBase_injective_of_exists_apply_eq
decls.doc:
If deck transformations act transitively on each fibre of `p`, the map from the
deck-orbit quotient to the base is injective.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientToBase_injective_of_exists_apply_eq
    (hpoint : ∀ {e e' : E}, p e = p e' → ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e') :
    Function.Injective (orbitQuotientToBase p)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.orbitQuotient_mk_eq_mk_iff_of_exists_apply_eq
decls.doc:
If deck transformations act transitively on each fibre of `p`, two points have the same
deck-orbit quotient class exactly when they have the same projection.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotient_mk_eq_mk_iff_of_exists_apply_eq
    (hpoint : ∀ {e e' : E}, p e = p e' → ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e') (e e' : E) :
    (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) = Quotient.mk'' e' ↔
      p e = p e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientToBase_injective
decls.doc: For a regular deck action, the map from deck-orbit quotient to the base is injective.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientToBase_injective (hreg : IsRegular p) :
    Function.Injective (orbitQuotientToBase p)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.apply_eq_iff_mem_orbit
decls.doc:
For a regular deck action, two points have the same projection exactly when they lie in a
common deck orbit.
decls.statement:
lemma apply_eq_iff_mem_orbit (hreg : IsRegular p) {e₁ e₂ : E} :
    p e₁ = p e₂ ↔ e₁ ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck p) e₂

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientEquivBase
decls.doc:
A regular deck action identifies the quotient of the total space by deck orbits with the
base.
decls.statement:
def orbitQuotientEquivBase (hreg : IsRegular p) :
    MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E ≃ B

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientEquivBase_mk
decls.doc:
The equivalence from the deck-orbit quotient to the base evaluates on representatives by
the projection map.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientEquivBase_mk (hreg : IsRegular p) (e : E) :
    hreg.orbitQuotientEquivBase
      (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) = p e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientEquivBase_symm_apply_proj
decls.doc: The inverse quotient-base equivalence sends a projected point to the class of any lift.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientEquivBase_symm_apply_proj (hreg : IsRegular p) (e : E) :
    hreg.orbitQuotientEquivBase.symm (p e) =
      (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotient_mk_eq_mk_iff
decls.doc:
For a regular deck action, two points have the same deck-orbit quotient class exactly when
they have the same projection.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotient_mk_eq_mk_iff (hreg : IsRegular p) (e e' : E) :
    (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) = Quotient.mk'' e' ↔
      p e = p e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientEquivBase_conj
decls.doc:
Transporting a regular deck action along an over-base homeomorphism is compatible with
the corresponding orbit-quotient equivalences.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientEquivBase_conj (hreg : IsRegular p) (h : E ≃ₜ F)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) :
    (hreg.conj h hpq).orbitQuotientEquivBase
      (orbitQuotientEquiv h hpq x) = hreg.orbitQuotientEquivBase x

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientEquivBase_conj_mk
decls.doc:
Representative form of compatibility between over-base homeomorphisms and the regular
orbit-quotient equivalences.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientEquivBase_conj_mk (hreg : IsRegular p) (h : E ≃ₜ F)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (f : F) :
    (hreg.conj h hpq).orbitQuotientEquivBase
      (Quotient.mk'' f : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck q) F) =
        hreg.orbitQuotientEquivBase
          (Quotient.mk'' (h.symm f) : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E)

decls.name: TauCeti.IsCoveringMap.isOpenQuotientMap
decls.doc: A surjective covering map is an open quotient map.
decls.statement:
theorem IsCoveringMap.isOpenQuotientMap (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective p) : IsOpenQuotientMap p

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.isQuotientCoveringMap
decls.doc:
A regular covering map with preconnected total space is a quotient covering map for its
deck transformation group: it presents the base as the quotient `E / Deck p`.
decls.statement:
theorem IsRegular.isQuotientCoveringMap [PreconnectedSpace E] (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (hp : IsCoveringMap p) : IsQuotientCoveringMap p (Deck p)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsQuotientCoveringMap.isRegular
decls.doc: A quotient covering map for the deck transformation group has regular deck action.
decls.statement:
theorem IsQuotientCoveringMap.isRegular (h : IsQuotientCoveringMap p (Deck p)) :
    IsRegular p

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.isQuotientCoveringMap_iff_isRegular
decls.doc:
For a covering map with preconnected total space, being a quotient covering map for the
deck transformation group is equivalent to regularity of the deck action.
decls.statement:
theorem isQuotientCoveringMap_iff_isRegular [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) :
    IsQuotientCoveringMap p (Deck p) ↔ IsRegular p

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.isOpenQuotientMap
decls.doc: A regular covering map is an open quotient map.
decls.statement:
theorem IsRegular.isOpenQuotientMap (hreg : IsRegular p) (hp : IsCoveringMap p) :
    IsOpenQuotientMap p

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.continuous_orbitQuotientToBase
decls.doc: A continuous map induces a continuous map from the deck-orbit quotient to the base.
decls.statement:
lemma continuous_orbitQuotientToBase (hp : Continuous p) :
    Continuous (orbitQuotientToBase p)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.isOpenMap_orbitQuotientToBase
decls.doc: An open map induces an open map from the deck-orbit quotient to the base.
decls.statement:
lemma isOpenMap_orbitQuotientToBase (hp : IsOpenMap p) :
    IsOpenMap (orbitQuotientToBase p)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase
decls.doc:
For a regular continuous open map, the deck-orbit quotient `E / Deck p` is homeomorphic to
the base.

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase_apply
decls.doc:
On the underlying equivalence, the orbit-quotient homeomorphism is
`orbitQuotientEquivBase`.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase_apply (hreg : IsRegular p) (hcont : Continuous p)
    (hopen : IsOpenMap p)
    (x : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) :
    hreg.orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase hcont hopen x = hreg.orbitQuotientEquivBase x

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase_mk
decls.doc: The orbit-quotient homeomorphism evaluates on representatives by the projection map.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase_mk (hreg : IsRegular p) (hcont : Continuous p)
    (hopen : IsOpenMap p) (e : E) :
    hreg.orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase hcont hopen
      (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E) = p e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase_symm_apply_proj
decls.doc:
The inverse orbit-quotient homeomorphism sends a projected point to the class of any
lift.
decls.statement:
lemma orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase_symm_apply_proj (hreg : IsRegular p) (hcont : Continuous p)
    (hopen : IsOpenMap p) (e : E) :
    (hreg.orbitQuotientHomeomorphBase hcont hopen).symm (p e) =
      (Quotient.mk'' e : MulAction.orbitRel.Quotient (Deck p) E)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular
decls.doc:
The deck action of a map is regular when the map is surjective and the deck group acts
transitively on every fibre.

For covering maps between connected, locally path-connected spaces this is the usual
deck-action formulation of a regular covering. The definition is kept independent of
`IsCoveringMap` so it can also be transported along isomorphisms of maps without carrying
unused topological hypotheses.
decls.statement: def IsRegular (p : E → B) : Prop

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.isRegular_iff
decls.doc: Characteristic restatement of regularity of the deck action.
decls.statement:
lemma isRegular_iff :
    IsRegular p ↔
      Function.Surjective p ∧ ∀ b : B, MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.isRegular_iff_exists_apply_eq
decls.doc: Characteristic pointwise restatement of regularity of the deck action.
decls.statement:
lemma isRegular_iff_exists_apply_eq :
    IsRegular p ↔
      Function.Surjective p ∧
        ∀ {e e' : E}, p e = p e' → ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.nonempty_fiber
decls.doc: A regular deck action has nonempty fibres.
decls.statement: lemma nonempty_fiber (hreg : IsRegular p) (b : B) : Nonempty (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.fiber_isPretransitive
decls.doc: The deck action on each fibre of a regular map is transitive.
decls.statement:
lemma fiber_isPretransitive (hreg : IsRegular p) (b : B) :
    MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.exists_apply_eq
decls.doc:
For a regular map, any two points with the same projection differ by a deck
transformation.
decls.statement:
lemma exists_apply_eq (hreg : IsRegular p) {e e' : E} (heq : p e = p e') :
    ∃ φ : Deck p, φ.1 e = e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.conj
decls.doc: Regularity of the deck action is transported by an over-base homeomorphism.
decls.statement: lemma conj (hreg : IsRegular p) (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) : IsRegular q

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.conj_iff
decls.doc: Regularity is invariant under an over-base homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma conj_iff (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) :
    IsRegular q ↔ IsRegular p

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber
decls.doc:
For a preconnected covering with regular deck action, evaluation at a chosen fibre point
identifies the deck group with that fibre.
decls.statement:
def deckEquivFiber [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) : Deck p ≃ p ⁻¹' {b}

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber_apply
decls.doc:
The equivalence from deck transformations to a fibre evaluates a deck transformation at
the chosen fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_apply [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    deckEquivFiber hp hreg e φ = φ • e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber_apply_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, the deck-to-fibre equivalence is evaluation of the underlying
homeomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_apply_coe [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (deckEquivFiber hp hreg e φ : E) = φ.1 e.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber_one
decls.doc:
The equivalence from deck transformations to a fibre sends the identity to the chosen
base point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_one [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    deckEquivFiber hp hreg e 1 = e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber_mul
decls.doc:
The equivalence from deck transformations to a fibre is equivariant for left
multiplication on the deck group and the deck action on the fibre.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_mul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ ψ : Deck p) :
    deckEquivFiber hp hreg e (φ * ψ) = φ • deckEquivFiber hp hreg e ψ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber_symm_smul
decls.doc:
The inverse of `deckEquivFiber` is characterized by the deck transformation it returns:
it sends the chosen fibre point to the requested fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_symm_smul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (deckEquivFiber hp hreg e).symm e' • e = e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber_symm_apply_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, the inverse of `deckEquivFiber` sends the chosen point to the
requested point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_symm_apply_coe [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (((deckEquivFiber hp hreg e).symm e').1 e.1 : E) = e'.1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber_symm_apply_smul
decls.doc:
Translating a fibre point before applying the inverse `deckEquivFiber` multiplies the
corresponding deck transformation on the left.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_symm_apply_smul [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (deckEquivFiber hp hreg e).symm (φ • e') =
      φ * (deckEquivFiber hp hreg e).symm e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberTorsor
decls.doc: The fibre of a regular preconnected covering is a torsor for its deck group.
decls.statement:
def fiberTorsor [PreconnectedSpace E]
    (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p) (b : B) :
    Torsor (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiber_sdiv_eq_deckEquivFiber_symm
decls.doc:
In the regular-cover fibre torsor, `e₁ /ₛ e₂` is the inverse equivalence from `e₂`
applied to `e₁`.
decls.statement:
lemma fiber_sdiv_eq_deckEquivFiber_symm [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (e₁ e₂ : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    letI

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.deckEquivFiber_symm_eq_sdiv
decls.doc:
In the regular-cover fibre torsor, the inverse of `deckEquivFiber` computes the quotient
of a point by the chosen base point.
decls.statement:
lemma deckEquivFiber_symm_eq_sdiv [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    letI

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient
decls.doc:
The quotient of the fibre over `b` by the restricted action of a subgroup of the deck
group.
decls.statement: abbrev SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (b : B) : Type _

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitClass
decls.doc: The `H`-orbit class of a point in one fibre.
decls.statement:
def subgroupFiberOrbitClass (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitClass_eq_mk
decls.doc: The subgroup fibre-orbit quotient map sends a fibre point to its own class.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitClass_eq_mk (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e =
      (Quotient.mk'' e : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitClass_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Two fibre points have the same `H`-orbit class exactly when they lie in the same
`H`-orbit. The orientation follows `MulAction.orbitRel_apply`: the left point is in the orbit
of the right point.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitClass_eq_iff (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e = subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e' ↔ e ∈ MulAction.orbit H e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitClass_smul_eq_base_iff
decls.doc:
A deck translate of the chosen fibre point has the same subgroup orbit class as the chosen
point exactly when the translating deck transformation lies in the subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitClass_smul_eq_base_iff
    [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b})
    (φ : Deck p) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitClass H (φ • e) = subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e ↔ φ ∈ H

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitClass_smul_eq_base_iff_of_isCoveringMap
decls.doc:
For a preconnected covering, a deck translate of the chosen fibre point has the same
subgroup orbit class as the chosen point exactly when the translating deck transformation lies
in the subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitClass_smul_eq_base_iff_of_isCoveringMap
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitClass H (φ • e) = subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e ↔ φ ∈ H

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE
decls.doc: If `H ≤ K`, the quotient of a fibre by `H` maps naturally to the quotient by `K`.
decls.statement:
def subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE {H K : Subgroup (Deck p)} (hHK : H ≤ K) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b → SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient K b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_apply
decls.doc: The map induced by `H ≤ K` sends the `H`-class of a point to its `K`-class.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_apply {H K : Subgroup (Deck p)} (hHK : H ≤ K)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) hHK (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass K e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_refl
decls.doc:
The map induced by the identity inclusion is the identity on the subgroup fibre-orbit
quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_refl (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) (le_rfl : H ≤ H) =
      id

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_comp
decls.doc: The maps induced by subgroup inclusions compose as expected.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_comp {H K L : Subgroup (Deck p)}
    (hHK : H ≤ K) (hKL : K ≤ L) :
    (subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) hKL) ∘
        subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) hHK =
      subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) (hHK.trans hKL)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotient_subsingleton_iff
decls.doc:
A subgroup fibre-orbit quotient is subsingleton exactly when that subgroup acts
transitively on the fibre.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotient_subsingleton_iff (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    Subsingleton (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) ↔
      MulAction.IsPretransitive H (p ⁻¹' {b})

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subsingleton_subgroupFiberOrbitQuotient_top
decls.doc:
If the full deck group acts transitively on a fibre, then the quotient of that fibre by
the full deck subgroup is a subsingleton.
decls.statement:
lemma subsingleton_subgroupFiberOrbitQuotient_top
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] :
    Subsingleton (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subsingleton_regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient_top
decls.doc:
For a regular cover, the quotient of a fibre by the full deck subgroup is a
subsingleton.
decls.statement:
lemma subsingleton_regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient_top (hreg : IsRegular p) :
    Subsingleton (SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.fiberMap_mem_orbit_subgroup_map
decls.doc:
Transporting a point in an `H`-orbit along an over-base homeomorphism puts the transported
point in the orbit for the conjugated subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma fiberMap_mem_orbit_subgroup_map (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) {e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}} (hee' : e ∈ MulAction.orbit H e') :
    fiberMap h hpq b e ∈
      MulAction.orbit (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
        (fiberMap h hpq b e')

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.mem_orbit_fiberMap_subgroup_map_iff
decls.doc:
Membership in a subgroup fibre-orbit is preserved by an over-base homeomorphism, with the
subgroup conjugated along the induced deck-group isomorphism.
decls.statement:
lemma mem_orbit_fiberMap_subgroup_map_iff (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    fiberMap h hpq b e ∈
        MulAction.orbit (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
          (fiberMap h hpq b e') ↔
      e ∈ MulAction.orbit H e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv
decls.doc:
An over-base homeomorphism identifies subgroup fibre-orbit quotients, conjugating the
subgroup of deck transformations along the induced deck-group isomorphism.
decls.statement:
def subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (b : B) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b ≃
      SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient
        (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The transported equivalence on subgroup fibre-orbit quotients sends a class to the class
of the transported fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_apply (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq H b (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass
        (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q))
        (fiberMap h hpq b e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse transported equivalence sends a target class to the class of its inverse
transport.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_symm_apply (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (f : q ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq H b).symm
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass
          (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) f) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H ((fiberMap h hpq b).symm f)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.cast_subgroupFiberOrbitClass
decls.doc:
Casting subgroup fibre-orbit quotients along an equality of subgroups carries the class of
a point to the corresponding class for the target subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma cast_subgroupFiberOrbitClass {H K : Subgroup (Deck p)} (hHK : H = K) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    Equiv.cast (congrArg (fun H' => SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H' b) hHK)
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass K e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_refl
decls.doc:
The identity over-base homeomorphism induces the identity on subgroup fibre-orbit
quotients, up to the canonical rewrite identifying the image of a subgroup under the identity
conjugation with the original subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_refl (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) :
    cast (congrArg (fun H' => SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H' b)
        (subgroup_map_conj_refl (p := p) H))
      (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (Homeomorph.refl E) (p := p) (q := p)
        (fun e => by change p e = p e; rfl) H b x) =
      x

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_trans
decls.doc:
Subgroup fibre-orbit quotient equivalences compose as the underlying over-base
homeomorphisms compose, with subgroup maps rewritten along conjugation composition.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_trans (h : E ≃ₜ F) (k : F ≃ₜ G)
    (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e) (hqr : ∀ f, r (k f) = q f) (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv (h.trans k)
        (fun e => by rw [Homeomorph.trans_apply, hqr, hpq]) H b x =
      Equiv.cast (congrArg (fun H' => SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H' b)
        (subgroup_map_conj_trans h k hpq hqr H))
        (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv k hqr
          (H.map ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) b
          (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq H b x))

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_mapOfLE
decls.doc:
Transport of subgroup fibre-orbit quotients is natural with respect to maps induced by
subgroup inclusions.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv_mapOfLE (h : E ≃ₜ F) (hpq : ∀ e, q (h e) = p e)
    {H K : Subgroup (Deck p)} (hHK : H ≤ K) :
    (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq K b) ∘
        subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) hHK =
      subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) (Subgroup.map_mono
        (f := ((conjMulEquiv h hpq : Deck p ≃* Deck q) : Deck p →* Deck q)) hHK) ∘
        subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquiv h hpq H b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv
decls.doc: Quotienting a fibre by the trivial deck subgroup gives the fibre itself.
decls.statement:
def subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) b ≃ p ⁻¹' {b}

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv_apply
decls.doc: The bottom-subgroup quotient equivalence sends a class to its representative fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv_apply (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv
        (p := p) (b := b) (subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e) = e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse bottom-subgroup quotient equivalence sends a fibre point to its quotient
class.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv_symm_apply (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv (p := p) (b := b)).symm e =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitClass_bot_eq_iff
decls.doc: Equality of bottom-subgroup fibre-orbit classes is equality of fibre points.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitClass_bot_eq_iff (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e =
        subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e' ↔
      e = e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_bot_apply
decls.doc:
The quotient map induced by `⊥ ≤ H`, after identifying the bottom quotient with the
fibre, is the `H`-orbit class map.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_bot_apply (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) ≤ H)
        ((subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv (p := p) (b := b)).symm e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_bot_eq
decls.doc:
The map from the bottom-subgroup quotient to the `H`-quotient is the `H`-orbit class map
under the bottom quotient equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_bot_eq (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (p := p) (b := b)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) ≤ H) =
      (fun e => subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) ∘
        subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv (p := p) (b := b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_bot_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Equality in an `H`-fibre quotient can be checked after choosing representatives through
the bottom quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_bot_eq_iff (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (x y : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (p := p) (b := b)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) ≤ H) x =
        subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (p := p) (b := b)
          (bot_le : (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) ≤ H) y ↔
      subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv (p := p) (b := b) x ∈
        _root_.MulAction.orbit H (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquiv (p := p) (b := b) y)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv
decls.doc: The quotient by the full deck group is the previously defined deck fibre-orbit quotient.
decls.statement:
def subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) b ≃ FiberOrbitQuotient p b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv_apply
decls.doc:
The top-subgroup quotient equivalence sends a class to the full deck-orbit class of the
same fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv_apply (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv
        (p := p) (b := b) (subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e) =
      fiberOrbitClass e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse top-subgroup quotient equivalence sends a full deck-orbit class to the class
for the top subgroup.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv_symm_apply (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv (p := p) (b := b)).symm (fiberOrbitClass e) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit
decls.doc:
The map from the quotient of one fibre by `H` to the full deck-orbit quotient, induced
by the subgroup inclusion `H ≤ ⊤`.
decls.statement:
def subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b → FiberOrbitQuotient p b

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_apply
decls.doc:
Forgetting from `H`-orbits to full deck orbits sends a class to the full orbit class of
the same fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_apply (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit H (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      fiberOrbitClass e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_top
decls.doc:
For `H = ⊤`, forgetting from `H`-orbits to full deck orbits is the top-subgroup
identification already supplied by `subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv`.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_top :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit (p := p) (b := b) (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv (p := p) (b := b)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitClass_top_eq_iff
decls.doc:
The top-subgroup equivalence identifies equality of top-subgroup classes with equality
of the corresponding full deck-orbit classes.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitClass_top_eq_iff (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e =
        subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e' ↔
      fiberOrbitClass e = fiberOrbitClass e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitClass_top_eq_iff_mem_orbit
decls.doc: Equality of top-subgroup fibre-orbit classes is membership in a full deck orbit.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitClass_top_eq_iff_mem_orbit (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e =
        subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e' ↔
      e ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck p) e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv_mapOfLE
decls.doc:
The map induced by `H ≤ ⊤`, after identifying the top quotient with the full deck-orbit
quotient, is `subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit`.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv_mapOfLE (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientTopEquiv (p := p) (b := b) ∘
        subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) (le_top : H ≤ (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p))) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit (p := p) (b := b) H

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_apply_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Equality after mapping two subgroup fibre-orbit representatives into a common
supergroup quotient is exactly membership in the common supergroup orbit.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_apply_eq_iff {H K L : Subgroup (Deck p)}
    (hHL : H ≤ L) (hKL : K ≤ L) (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) hHL (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
        subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) hKL (subgroupFiberOrbitClass K e') ↔
      e ∈ MulAction.orbit L e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Equality after mapping two subgroup fibre quotients into a common supergroup quotient
can be checked on representatives from the common supergroup orbit.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE_eq_iff {H K L : Subgroup (Deck p)}
    (hHL : H ≤ L) (hKL : K ≤ L)
    (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) (y : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient K b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) hHL x = subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) hKL y ↔
      ∃ e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}, x = subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e ∧
        y = subgroupFiberOrbitClass K e' ∧ e ∈ MulAction.orbit L e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_apply_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Equality after forgetting from `H`-orbits to full deck orbits is exactly membership of
representatives in the same full deck orbit.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_apply_eq_iff (H K : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit H (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
        subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit K (subgroupFiberOrbitClass K e') ↔
      e ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck p) e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq_iff
decls.doc:
Equality after forgetting from subgroup fibre quotients to full deck orbits can be
checked on representatives, even when the two subgroup quotients come from different
subgroups.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq_iff (H K : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) (y : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient K b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit H x = subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit K y ↔
      ∃ e e' : p ⁻¹' {b}, x = subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e ∧
        y = subgroupFiberOrbitClass K e' ∧ e ∈ MulAction.orbit (Deck p) e'

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_mapOfLE
decls.doc:
If `H ≤ K`, forgetting `H`-orbits to full deck orbits factors through the `K`-orbit
quotient.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_mapOfLE {H K : Subgroup (Deck p)} (hHK : H ≤ K)
    (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit K (subgroupFiberOrbitMapOfLE (b := b) hHK x) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit H x

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq
decls.doc:
If the full deck-orbit quotient of a fibre is a subsingleton, every `H`-fibre orbit maps
to the same full deck-orbit class as any chosen point of the fibre.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq [Subsingleton (FiberOrbitQuotient p b)]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit H x = fiberOrbitClass e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq_subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit
decls.doc:
If the full deck-orbit quotient of a fibre is a subsingleton, forgetting any two
subgroup fibre-orbit classes to full deck orbits gives the same result.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq_subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit
    [Subsingleton (FiberOrbitQuotient p b)] (H K : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) (y : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient K b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit H x = subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit K y

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq
decls.doc:
For a regular deck action, every `H`-fibre orbit maps to the same full deck-orbit class
as any chosen point of the fibre.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq (hreg : IsRegular p) (H : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit H x = fiberOrbitClass e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.IsRegular.subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq_subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit
decls.doc:
For a regular deck action, forgetting any two subgroup fibre-orbit classes to full deck
orbits gives the same result.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit_eq_subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit
    (hreg : IsRegular p) (H K : Subgroup (Deck p))
    (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b) (y : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient K b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit H x = subgroupFiberOrbitMapToFiberOrbit K y

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.quotientGroup_quotientBot_mk
decls.statement:
lemma quotientGroup_quotientBot_mk (φ : Deck p) :
    QuotientGroup.quotientBot (G := Deck p)
        (QuotientGroup.mk (s := (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p))) φ) =
      φ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup
decls.doc:
The subgroup-fibre orbit quotient is equivalent to the quotient of the deck group by the
subgroup, once the deck action on the chosen fibre is free and transitive.
decls.statement:
def subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b ≃ Deck p ⧸ H

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup
decls.doc:
For a regular preconnected covering map, the subgroup-fibre orbit quotient is equivalent
to the quotient of the deck group by the subgroup.
decls.statement:
def regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient H b ≃ Deck p ⧸ H

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_symm_mk
decls.doc:
The inverse quotient equivalence sends the coset of a deck transformation `φ` to the
`H`-orbit class of the point `φ⁻¹ • e`.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_symm_mk
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup H e).symm
        (QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) φ) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H (φ⁻¹ • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_symm_mk
decls.doc:
For a regular cover, the inverse quotient equivalence sends the coset of a deck
transformation `φ` to the `H`-orbit class of `φ⁻¹ • e`.
decls.statement:
lemma regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_symm_mk
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup hp hreg H e).symm
        (QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) φ) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H (φ⁻¹ • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_symm_mk_coe
decls.doc:
On underlying points, the inverse quotient equivalence sends the coset of `φ` to the
class of the value of `φ⁻¹` on the chosen fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_symm_mk_coe
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup H e).symm
        (QuotientGroup.mk φ) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H
        ⟨φ.1.symm e.1, by
          rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
          exact (map_proj φ⁻¹ e.1).trans (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp e.2)⟩

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_symm_one
decls.doc:
The inverse quotient equivalence sends the identity coset to the orbit class of the chosen
fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_symm_one
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup H e).symm
        (QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) (1 : Deck p)) =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_inv_smul
decls.doc: The quotient equivalence sends the orbit class of `φ⁻¹ • e` to the coset of `φ`.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_inv_smul
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup H e
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H (φ⁻¹ • e)) =
      QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) φ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_inv_smul
decls.doc:
For a regular cover, the quotient equivalence sends the orbit class of `φ⁻¹ • e` to the
coset of `φ`.
decls.statement:
lemma regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_inv_smul
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup hp hreg H e
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H (φ⁻¹ • e)) =
      QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) φ

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_base
decls.doc: The quotient equivalence sends the chosen fibre point to the identity coset.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_base
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup H e
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H e) =
      QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) (1 : Deck p)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_smul
decls.doc: The quotient equivalence sends the orbit class of `φ • e` to the coset of `φ⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_smul
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup H e
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H (φ • e)) =
      QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) φ⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_smul
decls.doc:
For a regular cover, the quotient equivalence sends the orbit class of `φ • e` to the
coset of `φ⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
lemma regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_apply_smul
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (H : Subgroup (Deck p)) (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup hp hreg H e
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass H (φ • e)) =
      QuotientGroup.mk (s := H) φ⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck
decls.doc:
For a free transitive deck action on a fibre, quotienting the fibre by the trivial
subgroup identifies that quotient with the deck group. The representative convention is the
same as `subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup`: the class of `φ • e` corresponds to
`φ⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
def subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) b ≃ Deck p

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck
decls.doc:
For a regular preconnected covering map, the quotient of a fibre by the trivial deck
subgroup is the deck group.
decls.statement:
def regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) b ≃ Deck p

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_apply_smul
decls.doc: The bottom-subgroup quotient-to-deck equivalence sends the class of `φ • e` to `φ⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_apply_smul
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck e
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) (φ • e)) =
      φ⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_apply_smul
decls.doc:
For a regular cover, the bottom-subgroup quotient-to-deck equivalence sends the class of
`φ • e` to `φ⁻¹`.
decls.statement:
lemma regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_apply_smul
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck hp hreg e
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) (φ • e)) =
      φ⁻¹

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_apply_base
decls.doc:
The chosen fibre point maps to the identity deck transformation under the
bottom-subgroup quotient-to-deck equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_apply_base
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck e
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e) =
      1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_apply_base
decls.doc:
For a regular cover, the chosen fibre point maps to the identity deck transformation
under the bottom-subgroup quotient-to-deck equivalence.
decls.statement:
lemma regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_apply_base
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) :
    regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck hp hreg e
        (subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e) =
      1

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_symm_apply
decls.doc:
The inverse bottom-subgroup quotient-to-deck equivalence sends a deck transformation to
the class of its inverse acting on the chosen fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_symm_apply
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck e).symm φ =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) (φ⁻¹ • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_symm_apply
decls.doc:
For a regular cover, the inverse bottom-subgroup quotient-to-deck equivalence sends a
deck transformation to the class of its inverse acting on the chosen fibre point.
decls.statement:
lemma regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck_symm_apply
    [TopologicalSpace B] [PreconnectedSpace E] (hp : IsCoveringMap p) (hreg : IsRegular p)
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (φ : Deck p) :
    (regularSubgroupFiberOrbitQuotientBotEquivDeck hp hreg e).symm φ =
      subgroupFiberOrbitClass (⊥ : Subgroup (Deck p)) (φ⁻¹ • e)

decls.name: TauCeti.Deck.subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_top
decls.doc:
Under the quotient-group equivalence, the full-subgroup fibre quotient lands in the
unique coset of `Deck p ⧸ ⊤`.
decls.statement:
lemma subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup_top
    [MulAction.IsPretransitive (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})] [IsCancelSMul (Deck p) (p ⁻¹' {b})]
    (e : p ⁻¹' {b}) (x : SubgroupFiberOrbitQuotient (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) b) :
    subgroupFiberOrbitQuotientEquivQuotientGroup (⊤ : Subgroup (Deck p)) e x =
